Out of the total, 8 posts are reserved for PwBD across categories (a) – blindness and low vision, (b) – deaf and hard of hearing, (c) – locomotor disability and related conditions, and (d & e) – autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability, mental illness and multiple disabilities.

ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026 – Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Notification 19 May 2026
Last Date for Receipt of Application (All India) 27 July 2026
Last Date for Remote Area Candidates 03 August 2026 (for candidates from NE States, J&K Ladakh division, specified HP districts, Andaman & Nicobar, Lakshadweep etc.)

ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must ensure that they satisfy all eligibility conditions relating to nationality, age, educational qualifications and teaching experience as of the closing date of receipt of applications.

Criteria Details
Nationality / Citizenship Candidate must be a citizen of India; certain categories of Nepal, Bhutan, Tibetan refugees and PIO from specified countries may also apply, subject to Government of India eligibility certificate.
Age Limit (UR / EWS) Not exceeding 50 years for Professor as on closing date of applications (27.07.2026 for most candidates).
Age Relaxation Up to 5 years for ESIC / Government servants; 5 years for SC/ST; 3 years for OBC; 10 years for PwBD (with cumulative maximum as per rules); additional relaxations for Ex‑Servicemen as per Government orders.
Educational Qualification – Medical Candidates
  • A recognised medical qualification included in First or Second Schedule or Part‑II of Third Schedule to IMC Act 1956, fulfilling Section 13(3) conditions where applicable.
  • Postgraduate qualification – MD/MS or equivalent in the concerned subject or allied discipline.
Educational Qualification – Non‑Medical Candidates Postgraduate degree (Master’s) in concerned subject/allied discipline and a Doctorate degree (PhD) from a recognised University in the respective subject/allied discipline, as per MCI/NMC “Minimum Qualifications for Teachers in Medical Institutions Regulations”.
Teaching Experience
  • Four years’ teaching experience as Reader/Associate Professor in a recognised medical college in the concerned specialty; OR
  • Three years’ teaching experience as Associate Professor in the concerned specialty, with at least four research publications in indexed/national journals as first author, of which minimum two are during Associate Professor tenure.
Experience Recognition Teaching experience must be recognised by Medical Council of India/National Medical Commission or relevant statutory body; experience as General Duty Medical Officer is not counted.
PwBD Eligibility Only persons with minimum 40% benchmark disability in notified categories are eligible for PwBD reservation and age relaxation; only disabilities identified as suitable for each specialty as per the notification will be considered.

ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026 – Pay Scale & Emoluments

Selected candidates will be appointed in Pay Level‑13 of the 7th CPC pay matrix with Non‑Practicing Allowance and other admissible benefits.

  • Basic Pay: Level‑13 (Rs. 1,23,100 – 2,15,900) in the pay matrix.
  • Allowances: Dearness Allowance (DA), Non‑Practicing Allowance (NPA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance and other allowances as per Central Government/ESIC rules.
  • Career Prospects: Promotional avenues available under DACP guidelines; opportunities for academic and research growth within ESIC medical institutions.

ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026 – Application Fee

Application fee is payable via Demand Draft/Banker’s Cheque only, in favour of “ESI Fund Account No. 2” payable at Delhi.

Category Application Fee
General / OBC / EWS / ESIC & Departmental Male Candidates Rs. 500/- (non‑refundable)
SC / ST / PwBD / Women (all categories) / Ex‑Servicemen No Fee

Fee once paid will not be refunded in any circumstances and applications without the prescribed fee (where applicable) will be rejected without correspondence.

ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Selection will be made on the basis of an Interview conducted by the ESIC Selection Board, with possible shortlisting based on experience.

  • If the number of applications is large, ESIC may shortlist candidates for interview based on teaching experience beyond the minimum required level (Associate Professor/Reader or above) as per Recruitment Rules.
  • Category‑wise minimum qualifying marks in interview: UR/EWS – 50, OBC – 45, SC/ST/PwBD – 40 out of 100 marks.
  • Tie‑breaking: older candidate by age is preferred; if still tied, earlier date of passing essential PG degree; if still tied, earlier date of completion of internship is considered.
  • A Reserve List may be maintained as per UPSC‑like provisions.

ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026 – Age Relaxation & Reservation Notes

ESIC follows Government of India rules on age relaxation, community reservation and PwBD concessions.

  • SC/ST – up to 5 years; OBC – up to 3 years; PwBD – up to 10 years (maximum age on closing date not exceeding 56 years), with cumulative relaxation for SC/ST/OBC PwBD as per norms.
  • Ex‑Servicemen and ECOs/SSCOs – age relaxation up to 5 years subject to conditions on length of service and release certificates.
  • Only candidates belonging to castes/communities in the Central List of SC/ST/OBC and having valid, current certificates in the prescribed format will get reservation benefits; multiple applications in different categories will lead to rejection.

How to Apply – ESIC Professor Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted offline only in the prescribed application form attached with the notification. No online application facility is available for this recruitment.

Step‑by‑Step Offline Application Process:

  1. Download and print the official notification and Application Form for “Professor in ESI Corporation‑2026” from ESIC website or your job portal.
  2. Fill the application form in BLOCK letters with accurate details such as specialty applied for, personal information, educational qualifications, teaching experience, registration details and publication list.
  3. Prepare a Demand Draft/Banker’s Cheque of Rs. 500/- (if applicable) in favour of “ESI Fund Account No. 2”, payable at Delhi, issued after the date of advertisement.
  4. Attach self‑attested copies of required documents (educational certificates, experience certificates, caste/EWS/PwBD certificates, proof of age, research publications, etc.) as per the checklist.
  5. Affix a recent self‑attested passport size photograph in the space provided on the application form.
  6. Place the filled and signed application form along with DD/Banker’s Cheque and enclosures in an envelope superscribed “Application for the post of Professor for Medical Institutions”.
  7. Send the application preferably by Speed Post to the address given below so as to reach on or before 27.07.2026 (03.08.2026 for specified remote areas).

Application Sending Address:

Postal Address Regional Office Delhi, ESI Corporation, DDA Complex‑cum‑Office, 3rd & 4th Floor, Rajendra Bhawan, Rajendra Place, New Delhi – 110008
DD/Banker’s Cheque Payable at Delhi

Applications received after the last date or without proper documents/fees will be rejected, and ESIC will not be responsible for postal delays.

Documents Required with ESIC Professor Application

Candidates must attach self‑attested copies of all relevant documents along with the application form.

  • Original Demand Draft/Banker’s Cheque pinned on top of the application form with candidate’s name and address written on the reverse.
  • Recent passport size photograph (self‑attested) firmly pasted on the application form.
  • Matriculation/10th certificate or mark sheet indicating Date of Birth; in some cases, school leaving certificate for TN & Kerala.
  • Degree certificates and mark sheets of all academic years (MBBS, PG, PhD etc.); provisional certificates accepted if final degree is awaited.
  • Experience certificates from Heads of Organisations clearly mentioning post, period, pay and nature of duties, and specifying recognition as teaching experience by MCI/NMC or relevant body.
  • Certificates/testimonials supporting research publications and academic achievements.
  • Category certificates: SC/ST/OBC/EWS in prescribed Central Government format; OBC non‑creamy layer declaration; EWS Income & Asset certificate.
  • PwBD certificate in prescribed format for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities.
  • Documents for age relaxation (Ex‑Servicemen, Central/UT Govt employees etc.) in the prescribed formats.
  • Any other supporting documents for claims made in the application (name change, etc.).

Important Instructions for ESIC Professor Applicants

  • Eligibility (age, qualifications, experience etc.) is calculated with reference to the closing date of applications – 27.07.2026 for most candidates.
  • Mere submission of application or call for interview does not confer any right to appointment; candidature remains provisional until verification.
  • Incomplete/unsigned applications, or those not in prescribed proforma, without required documents, fee, or received after the last date will be rejected without communication.
  • Any false statement or suppression of material information can lead to cancellation of candidature/appointment at any stage.
  • Selected candidates will be on probation as per ESIC rules and are liable to be posted anywhere in India; state preferences are only indicative and not binding.

BRO GREF Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

BRO GREF Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

All candidates will undergo the recruitment process in the following sequence: (i) Written Examination, (ii) Physical Efficiency Test (PET) including physical measurements and Trade Test (TT) where applicable, (iii) Primary Medical Examination (PME) and Document Verification (DV), and (iv) Induction/Joining. The PET and TT are qualifying in nature - final merit is based solely on written exam marks, subject to qualifying PET, TT, and clearing PME. Minimum passing marks in written exam: 50% for UR/EWS/OBC; 40% for SC/ST. Trade test requires minimum 40% marks to qualify.

Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Candidate must complete 1.6 km (1 mile) run in 10 minutes. PwBD, ESM, Ex-Agniveers, and departmental re-appointment candidates are exempt from PET.

Competition Level Analysis for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026

The competition level for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026 is expected to be moderate to high. The recruitment is restricted to Male candidates only, which reduces the applicant pool compared to open-gender recruitments. However, 899 vacancies across technical/trade posts will attract a large number of ITI-qualified and Matriculation-level candidates, especially for high-vacancy posts like Store Keeper Technical (300) and Operator Communication (261). The written exam followed by PET and Trade Test provides multiple elimination stages, but candidates with relevant ITI trade certificates and physical fitness will have a clear advantage. Ex-Servicemen and Ex-Agniveers get significant age relaxation and weightage, which makes certain trades more competitive in that segment.

The key differentiator here is the offline application process - many eligible candidates may miss out due to postal delays or incorrect application format, effectively reducing actual competition at the written exam stage. Candidates who submit complete and correct applications well before the deadline and prepare trade-specific written exam syllabi will have a significant edge.

Who should NOT apply for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026?

  • Female candidates - this recruitment is strictly for Indian National Males only.
  • Candidates who do not possess the requisite educational/technical qualification as on the closing date of application; those awaiting final exam results are not eligible.
  • Candidates outside the age band 18-27 years as on 01 Jun 2026 (except those eligible for applicable category-based relaxation).
  • OBC candidates from the Creamy Layer - they are not entitled to OBC reservation or age relaxation and must apply as UR/General category.
  • Candidates who cannot meet the region-wise physical standards (height, chest, weight) as physical fitness is mandatory for induction.
  • Candidates with permanent medical conditions listed as grounds for permanent rejection (colour blindness for Drivers/Operators, cardiac conditions, gross myopia, etc.) who cannot pass the Primary Medical Examination at GREF Centre.
  • Candidates unwilling or unable to be posted anywhere in India, especially in remote, high-altitude, or difficult terrain areas in Northern and Eastern regions.
  • Candidates who cannot arrange and send a physical application form with photograph, thumb impression, signature, fee e-receipt, and attested copies by post to Pune - there is no online application mode.
  • Candidates with tattoos on any body part other than the inner forearm (inside elbow to wrist) or reverse palm - tattoos on other parts lead to disqualification at PME.
  • Ex-servicemen who have already joined Govt civil service using ESM benefits and are claiming ESM status again - such candidates are treated as civilian employees.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying BRO GREF Recruitment 2026?

  • Not printing the application form on A4 size 75 GSM bond paper (one side only) and admit card on both sides of a single paper as mandated - non-standard paper leads to rejection.
  • Applying without attaching the e-receipt copy of the application fee paid via SBI Collect; no other payment mode is accepted and missing receipt causes rejection.
  • Sending the application from a wrong/old address instead of present postal address - applications posted from wrong address are rejected to prevent fraudulent claims of 60-day receipt benefit.
  • Not superscribing the envelope with "APPLICATION FOR (NAME OF TRADE/POST) Under Category (UR/SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/ESM/CPL)" as required - unlabelled envelopes may be misdirected.
  • Mismatch between name in application and name in Matriculation certificate - even a dropped or added part of the name requires a Gazette Notification; otherwise candidature is summarily cancelled.
  • Submitting multiple applications for the same post with different details or photographs - this results in lifetime debarment from all GREF examinations.
  • OBC/EWS certificate dated older than one year from the closing date - OBC and EWS certificates must be fresh (not older than one year as on closing date) and in the prescribed Central Govt format.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post/trade using the same envelope - each post requires a separate application with separate fee in a separate envelope.
  • Not carrying the minimum 12 passport-size photographs (same as pasted on application and admit card) to all subsequent recruitment stages - shortage of photos causes disruption at PET/TT/PME stages.
  • Ignoring the trade-specific syllabus and treating the written exam as a general knowledge test - each post has a distinct subject-wise syllabus and candidates must prepare trade-specific topics.

How to Apply for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply offline only; no online application mode is available. Application form and admit card must be downloaded from the official BRO website (www.bro.gov.in) and filled in English or Hindi only, in capital letters. The application form must be printed on A4 size 75 GSM bond paper (one side only) and admit card printed on both sides of a single paper. Candidates must first pay the application fee online via SBI Collect portal and attach the e-receipt copy. Candidates applying for more than one post must send separate applications with separate fee in separate envelopes. Candidates are strongly advised to send applications well before the closing date and not wait for the last day - GREF Centre will not be responsible for postal delays.

Candidates should read the detailed instructions and guidelines available at https://bfsissc.com before applying.

Documents Required to be Enclosed with Application Form:

  • Recent colour passport-size photograph (not older than 1 month from the date of Advertisement) pasted at the prescribed place on application form and admit card - minimum 12 copies of the same photograph to be carried throughout the recruitment process
  • Left hand thumb impression at the prescribed place on application form and admit card
  • Signature of candidate at the prescribed place
  • Copy of e-receipt of application fee paid via SBI Collect
  • Self-attested photostat copies of certificates for essential educational/technical qualifications (Matriculation onwards), date of birth, caste certificate (as per format in Appendix A/B), OBC NCL declaration (Appendix D), EWS certificate (Appendix C), Disability Certificate (Appendix E for PwBD), experience certificate (if applicable), Driving Licence copy (for OEM post)
  • NCC certificate copies (B or C grade), sports certificate, or relationship certificate for Sons of Serving/Ex-GREF personnel - for claiming weightage marks
  • Proof of residence/domicile (for correct physical standards region)
  • Any certificate in language other than Hindi or English must be enclosed with an attested Hindi/English translation by a Group A Gazetted Officer

Send Application (by Postal Service) to: Commandant, GREF Centre, Dighi Camp, Pune - 411015

Printout / physical application is NOT to be sent anywhere else. No hard copy of admit card for written exam will be sent by post - admit card will be posted to the communication address given by the candidate in the admit card.

Application form available at: https://www.bro.gov.in

For queries: Visit https://www.bro.gov.in - all recruitment updates, results, and call letters will be displayed on the BRO website only.

Important Instructions for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only Male Indian Nationals can apply; Female candidates are not eligible.
  • Application form and/or admit card without signature, without photograph, or without thumb impression will be summarily rejected - no communication will be done for rejected applications.
  • Candidates must ensure their Aadhaar Card photo is current (not older than 2-3 years from written exam date) and address/phone is updated; outdated Aadhaar may prevent entry to the exam.
  • Son of Serving / Ex-GREF staff should write father's GS No., Rank, and Name on top of the application in red ink with a photocopy of relationship certificate, to claim the 15% weightage benefit.
  • Casual Paid Labours (CPL) of GREF who have worked for 179 days in the last one year and are on the Muster Roll on the date of advertisement publication get 10% additional weightage - attach experience certificate signed by OC unit, countersigned by Commander BRTF and verified by Accounts Officer.
  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates who qualify on their own merit (without relaxed standards) will be accommodated against UR vacancies - they must NOT apply separately against UR vacancies.
  • OBC candidates belonging to Creamy Layer are not entitled to reservation; they should apply under UR category.
  • Candidates serving in other Government Departments must apply through proper channel sufficiently in advance; applications not received by due date through proper channel will be rejected.
  • Mobile phones, smartwatches, and all electronic/communication devices are strictly NOT ALLOWED inside GREF Centre, Pune campus during any recruitment process.
  • A candidate who absents himself during any recruitment activity for which he has been called will have his candidature cancelled automatically - he will not be allowed to appear for further stages.
  • There shall be no provision for re-evaluation/re-checking of scores in examination; no correspondence in this regard shall be entertained.
  • Legal jurisdiction for any dispute arising out of this Advertisement shall fall within the jurisdiction of the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi.
  • Impersonation or submission of forged documents leads to debarment from all GREF examinations for life/2 years and legal action. GREF has not appointed any agent or coaching centre for action on its behalf - SELECTION WILL BE DONE PURELY ON MERIT IN A TRANSPARENT MANNER.
  • Vacancies are liable to increase/decrease/cancel at any stage without notice due to unforeseen situations.
  • All revisions/corrigendum will be hosted on the BRO website only - candidates should visit www.bro.gov.in regularly.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

Indian Air Force has released the latest AFCAT 02/2026 notification for recruitment of Men and Women as Group ‘A’ Gazetted Officers in the Flying Branch and Ground Duty (Technical and Non‑Technical) branches for courses commencing in July 2027. Online applications will be accepted from 20 May 2026 (1100 hrs) to 19 June 2026 (2330 hrs) through the official AFCAT website https://afcat.edcil.co.in, and the online AFCAT exam will be conducted on 08 August 2026 (Saturday). Interested and eligible candidates must ensure that they fulfill all eligibility conditions before applying.

FOLLOW US

Indian Air Force AFCAT 02/2026 Notification PDF

Indian Air Force has published the detailed notification titled “AIR FORCE COMMON ADMISSION TEST (AFCAT‑02/2026) FOR FLYING BRANCH AND GROUND DUTY (TECHNICAL AND NON‑TECHNICAL) BRANCHES / NCC SPECIAL ENTRY / GATE SCORE ENTRY FOR COURSES COMMENCING IN JULY 2027”. The notification includes complete information on branches, course numbers, vacancies, eligibility, age limits, educational qualifications, selection process, exam pattern, medical standards, training, and how to apply. Candidates must read the full notification carefully before submitting the online application form.

  • Download AFCAT 02/2026 Official Notification PDF

Indian Air Force AFCAT 02/2026 Overview

Organization Name Indian Air Force (IAF)
Exam Name Air Force Common Admission Test (AFCAT‑02/2026)
Course Commencement July 2027 (at Air Force Training Establishments)
Branches Flying Branch, Ground Duty (Technical), Ground Duty (Non‑Technical)

Indian Air Force AFCAT 02/2026 - Entry, Branch & Vacancies

AFCAT 02/2026 notification gives branch‑wise and entry‑wise vacancies, which are tentative and subject to change as per organisational requirements. Two seats in Ground Duty (Non‑Technical) are reserved for Law‑qualified candidates.

Indian Air Force AFCAT 02/2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must ensure that they satisfy all eligibility conditions of nationality, age, marital status, educational qualification and medical standards as on the prescribed dates. Their admission at all stages is purely provisional and will be cancelled if any ineligibility is detected at any stage.

Criteria Details
Nationality Candidate must be a citizen of India as per Indian Citizenship Act, 1955.
Age - Flying Branch (AFCAT & NCC Special Entry) 20 to 24 years as on 01 July 2027 i.e. born between 02 July 2003 and 01 July 2007 (both dates inclusive). Upper age limit relaxable up to 26 years (born between 02 July 2001 and 01 July 2007) for candidates holding valid and current Commercial Pilot License issued by DGCA (India).
Age - Ground Duty (Technical & Non‑Technical) 20 to 26 years as on 01 July 2027 i.e. born between 02 July 2001 and 01 July 2007 (both dates inclusive).
Marital Status Candidates must be unmarried at the time of commencement of course; marriage is not permitted during training. Candidates marrying during training will be discharged and liable to refund the training cost.
Educational Qualification - Flying Branch Must have passed with Mathematics and Physics at 10+2 level and one of the following: - Graduation (minimum 3‑year degree) in any discipline from a recognised University; or - BE/B.Tech (4‑year degree) from a recognised University; or - Section A & B examination of AMIE (India) or Aeronautical Society of India.
Educational Qualification - Ground Duty (Technical) AE(L) Candidates must have passed Physics and Mathematics at 10+2 and have a minimum 4‑year degree in Engineering/Technology in specified Electronics/Computer/Electrical/IT disciplines or equivalent as listed in para 5.3.2.1 of the notification.
Educational Qualification - Ground Duty (Technical) AE(M) Physics and Mathematics at 10+2 with a minimum 4‑year degree in specified Mechanical/Aeronautical/Production/Industrial/Automobile/Mechatronics/Metallurgy disciplines as listed in para 5.3.2.2.
Educational Qualification - Ground Duty (Non‑Technical) - Weapon Systems (WS): Maths & Physics at 10+2 and Graduation (3‑year degree) or BE/B.Tech. - Administration & Logistics: 10+2 and Graduation in any discipline or AMIE/ASI. - Accounts: 10+2 and B.Com/BBA(BFS‑Finance)/BMS(BFS‑Finance)/BBS(BFS‑Finance)/CA/CMA/CS/CFA/B.Sc (Finance). - Education: 10+2 and Post‑Graduation in any discipline (with Graduation in any discipline). - Meteorology: 10+2 and B.Sc with Physics & Mathematics or 4‑year Engineering/Technology degree in specified streams.
Final Year Candidates Candidates in final year/semester may apply if they have no present backlog at application time and can submit proof of passing by 30 May 2027.
NCC Special Entry Mandatory NCC Air Wing Senior Division ‘C’ Certificate acquired within two years from AFCAT registration date (backward calculation). Written exam is exempted; candidates are called directly for AFSB.
GATE Score Entry Candidates with BE/B.Tech in eligible branches and valid GATE score (last 3 years from course start) in notified subjects can apply; AFCAT exam is exempted; shortlisted candidates go directly to AFSB.
Disqualifications Candidates debarred by MoD from any Defence commission, those with criminal convictions or ongoing criminal cases, and those removed from NDA/IMA/AFA/INA/OTAs for indiscipline are ineligible.

Indian Air Force AFCAT 02/2026 - Type of Commission

Type of commission offered varies by branch and gender.

Permanent Commission (PC) Available for Men & Women; PC officers serve till superannuation in their respective branches.
Short Service Commission (SSC) - Flying Branch Engagement period of 14 years from the date of commissioning for Men and Women.
Short Service Commission (SSC) - Ground Duty (Technical & Non‑Technical) Initial tenure of 10 years with possible 4‑year extension based on service requirements, vacancies, willingness, suitability and merit.
Pension SSC officers are not entitled for pension; PC officers get pension as per rules.

Indian Air Force AFCAT 02/2026 - Application Fee

A non‑refundable examination fee is applicable for AFCAT entry; there is no fee for NCC Special Entry and GATE Score Entry.

Entry Examination Fee
AFCAT Entry (All Branches incl. Tech) Rs. 550/- plus 18% GST (non‑refundable).
NCC Special Entry / GATE Score Entry No AFCAT examination fee.

Indian Air Force AFCAT 02/2026 - Selection Process

The selection process comprises an online AFCAT exam, followed by Air Force Selection Board (AFSB) testing, medical examination and final merit list.

Stage 1 - AFCAT Online Examination

Exam Subject Duration No. of Questions Maximum Marks
AFCAT General Awareness, Verbal Ability in English, Numerical Ability, Reasoning & Military Aptitude Test. 2 Hours (120 Minutes) 100 300

Each correct answer carries 3 marks, each wrong answer attracts a penalty of 1 mark, and no marks are awarded for unattempted questions. The paper is in English only, and normalisation of marks is applied when multiple shifts are conducted.

Stage 2 - Air Force Selection Board (AFSB) Testing

  • Stage‑I: Officer Intelligence Rating Test and Picture Perception & Discussion Test on Day 1; this is a screening stage.
  • Stage‑II: Psychological tests, Group Tests and Personal Interview over the next days for Stage‑I qualified candidates.
  • CPSS: Computerised Pilot Selection System for Flying Branch candidates (once‑in‑a‑lifetime test; CPSS/PABT failures are ineligible for Flying Branch).

Stage 3 - Medical Examination & Final Merit

Candidates recommended by AFSB and found medically fit by the appropriate medical board are considered for training strictly in order of merit and branch‑wise vacancies. The final merit list is based on combined marks of AFCAT (where applicable) and AFSB.

Indian Air Force AFCAT 02/2026 - Exam Pattern & Syllabus

The AFCAT paper is of graduation‑level standard (except Numerical Ability, which is matriculation level) and tests a mix of aptitude and knowledge.

  • English: Comprehension, error detection, sentence completion, synonyms/antonyms, cloze test, idioms & phrases, analogy, sentence rearrangement, one‑word substitution, homonyms.
  • General Awareness: History, Geography, Sports, National & International Organisations, Art & Culture, Personalities, Environment & Ecology, Polity, Economy, Basic Science, Science & Technology, Current Affairs, Defence.
  • Numerical Ability: Fractions, Time & Work, Average, Percentage, Profit & Loss, Ratio & Proportion, Interest, Time & Distance, Area & Perimeter, Probability, Number System, Mixture & Allegation, Squares/Cubes, HCF & LCM, Mensuration, Heights & Distances, Statistics.
  • Reasoning & Military Aptitude: Verbal and Non‑Verbal Reasoning.

An online practice test is available on the IAF AFCAT website.

Indian Air Force AFCAT 02/2026 - Training, Pay & Allowances

Candidates recommended by AFSBs and found medically fit are detailed for training at Air Force Training Establishments based on merit and branch.

  • Training Date & Duration: Training is scheduled to commence in the first week of July 2027; duration is approximately 62 weeks for Flying and Ground Duty (Technical) branches and 50 weeks for Ground Duty (Non‑Technical).
  • Stipend during Training: Flight Cadets receive a fixed stipend of Rs. 56,100/- per month during one year of training (as per 7th CPC matrix).
  • Pay on Commissioning: Flying Officer - Pay Level 10 (Rs. 56,100-1,77,500) plus applicable MSP and allowances as per branch and posting.
  • Insurance: Officers are covered under Air Force Group Insurance Society (AFGIS), with Rs. 1.25 crore cover (on contribution) for death in service and Air Veterans Insurance Cover after retirement for eligible PC/SSC officers.

How to Apply for Indian Air Force AFCAT 02/2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the AFCAT website; no other mode is accepted. Aadhaar Card is mandatory for online registration, and candidates should use valid email ID and mobile number, which must remain active throughout the selection process.

Step‑by‑Step Process (AFCAT Entry):

  1. Visit the official AFCAT website https://afcat.edcil.co.in and read the advertisement and instructions carefully.
  2. Click on the sign‑up/registration link and enter full name, mobile number and email ID, then verify via OTP on email and mobile.
  3. Agree to the declaration, submit the registration form and obtain the system‑generated User ID and Password sent to registered email and mobile.
  4. Login with User ID and Password, click on “Go to Application”, and fill personal details, communication details, qualification details, course preferences and other required fields.
  5. Upload scanned images of recent passport size colour photograph (100-200 KB), signature (80-150 KB), thumb impression (50-100 KB) and live image capture as per specified formats.
  6. Carefully verify all details using “Preview” and then proceed to pay the examination fee of Rs. 550/- + GST (for AFCAT entry only) through online payment gateway (Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, UPI etc.).
  7. After successful payment and submission, download and print the final submitted application form for future reference.

Applicants should apply well before the last date to avoid last‑minute issues; once submitted, the application cannot be edited, and additional applications against the same Aadhaar will result in only the latest being considered.

Documents to Upload / Produce - AFCAT 02/2026

Scanned Documents to Upload (during Application):

  • Recent passport size colour photograph (100-200 KB; JPG/JPEG).
  • Signature in black ink on white paper (80-150 KB; JPG/JPEG).
  • Thumb impression - Left thumb (male) / Right thumb (female) (50-100 KB; JPG/JPEG/PDF).
  • Live image capture via device camera at the time of application.

Documents to Carry for AFCAT Exam & AFSB:

  • Printout of e‑Admit Card (AFCAT 02/2026).
  • Original Aadhaar Card and a second photo ID (PAN/Passport/Driving Licence/Voter ID etc.).
  • Two passport size colour photographs (same as uploaded).
  • Original and photocopies of Matriculation and 10+2 certificates and mark sheets.
  • Original/provisional Graduation/PG degree and mark sheets (for AFSB).
  • Certificate from College Principal for final year candidates specifying aggregate percentage and likely result date.
  • Original NCC ‘C’ Certificate (for NCC Special Entry) and GATE documents (for GATE Score Entry).
  • NOC from employer for Govt/PSU/Armed Forces personnel, if applicable.

Important Instructions for AFCAT 02/2026 Candidates

  • Candidates must ensure eligibility for the branch(es) they apply for; incorrect information at any stage leads to cancellation of candidature.
  • Use of unfair means or possession of prohibited items (mobile phones, smart watches, electronic devices, study material etc.) inside the exam hall will result in cancellation and debarment from future AFCATs.
  • No request for change of exam centre/date/slot will be entertained; centres may be changed by IAF based on administrative reasons.
  • Serving airmen must apply online like other candidates and also follow service procedures as per AFO 11/2015.
  • Use/possession of narcotics is strictly banned; candidates may be tested for drugs during medicals and training, and those found positive are liable for termination.
  • Permanent tattoos are permitted only on the inner forearms and back of hands (with conditions); non‑permissible tattoos or those with offensive/extremist content lead to rejection.
  • Training is rigorous; candidates should maintain good physical fitness (running, push‑ups, rope climbing, swimming etc.) before reporting to Air Force Academy.

AAICLAS Security Screener Recruitment 2026 - Pay, Allowances & Training Details

All provisionally selected and joined candidates will initially be given a stipend of Rs. 15,000/- per month. After successful passing of all requisite training examinations (fee and TA/DA for 1st attempt paid by AAICLAS), the stipend will be converted to full monthly remuneration. The contract of three years shall start after passing of all certification examinations and not from the date of joining on stipend.

In case a candidate fails in the 1st attempt, the monthly stipend is reduced to Rs. 10,000/- per month and training costs for the 2nd attempt must be borne by the candidate. If the candidate fails in the 2nd attempt, the Fixed Term Contract shall be terminated without further notice.

AAICLAS Security Screener Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Candidates with higher percentage of marks at Graduation level will be called first for online interaction in a phased manner, subject to availability of vacancies at a particular station/location. Selection will be done according to the merit list prepared on the basis of marks secured in the interview. Merely appearing in the interview does not reserve any right for selection.

The date of interaction will be intimated to candidates on their registered email IDs and by uploading a circular on the AAICLAS website www.aaiclas.aero. No TA/DA or reimbursement shall be made by AAICLAS for the selection process. After selection, candidates must provide a surety bond of Rs. 1,50,000/- on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 100/- (duly notarized) for non-completion of the 3-year engagement period.

Stage Details
Stage 1 Online Application submission at www.aaiclas.aero under "Career" column against Advt. No. 01/2026 on or before 08-06-2026
Stage 2 Shortlisting based on Graduation percentage (higher percentage called first in phased manner)
Stage 3 Online Interaction / Interview (date and mode intimated via registered email ID and AAICLAS website)
Stage 4 Medical Fitness Test (including eye/color blindness examination, vision and hearing, object recognition ability)
Stage 5 Final engagement on Fixed Term Contract basis; surety bond of Rs. 1,50,000/- to be submitted by selected candidates

How to Apply for AAICLAS Security Screener Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the AAICLAS official website www.aaiclas.aero by clicking on the "Apply Now" tab against Advertisement No. 01 of 2026 under the "Career" column. No application will be accepted after 08-06-2026. Applications received through Speed Post, Registered Post, Ordinary Post or Couriers will not be accepted. Only online applications will be accepted.

Candidates can apply for a single location only. Only a single application will be accepted from each candidate. The email ID entered in the application form must remain active until the engagement process is completed; no change in email ID will be allowed once entered. All communications by AAICLAS regarding this recruitment will be made only on the registered email ID of the candidates and not by post.

While filling the online form, percentage of marks of Graduation must be entered in numeric form only (e.g. 60, 70, 80 etc.) and not in CGPA grade or any other format. Candidates already working in any Government Department/PSU/Autonomous Body must produce an NOC from their present employer.

Documents to be Attached with the Online Application Form:

  • Matriculation / Higher Secondary Certificates
  • Graduation Certificate / Degree or Provisional Degree Certificate
  • Graduation Mark-sheet
  • Caste / Category Certificate (if applicable)
  • Aadhaar Card copy
  • One recent passport size coloured photograph (max 20KB size)
  • Application Fee payment proof (online)
  • Scanned Signature (max 20KB size)

*At the time of joining (if selected), candidates must bring all original certificates/mark sheets/experience certificates/professional qualification certificates/training certificates/Aadhaar Card/PAN Card/Police Clearance Certificate (PCC)/Category Certificate (if applicable)/other documents along with one set of self-attested copies.

Important Instructions for AAICLAS Security Screener Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Candidates not willing to serve on All India Basis need not apply.
  • Only a single application per candidate will be accepted and candidates can apply for a single location only.
  • Candidates selected under previous AAICLAS advertisements in the last 3 years and terminated due to failure in trainings/examinations need not apply.
  • Percentage of marks at Graduation must be entered in numeric form only; CGPA or any other format will not be accepted.
  • All communications from AAICLAS will be made only on the registered email ID; candidates must keep checking their registered email regularly.
  • No change in email ID will be allowed once entered in the application form.
  • After selection, candidates must submit a surety bond of Rs. 1,50,000/- on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 100/- (duly notarized) for non-completion of the 3-year engagement period.
  • The contract period of 3 years starts after passing all certification examinations and not from the date of joining on stipend.
  • During stipend period only one casual leave per month shall be applicable on pro-rata basis.
  • Maximum two attempts will be given for qualifying certification examinations; failure in both attempts leads to termination of Fixed Term Contract without further notice.
  • Training costs for the 2nd attempt (if applicable) must be borne by the candidate; AAICLAS will only make the nomination.
  • Notice period for resignation is minimum 3 months; those resigning with immediate effect must deposit 3 months' salary and no experience letter/verification will be issued.
  • Candidates working in Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies must produce a NOC from their present employer.
  • Furnishing false/incorrect information or suppression of material facts at any stage will result in cancellation of candidature or termination of engagement.
  • No TA/DA or reimbursement shall be made by AAICLAS for the selection process.
  • The job is transferable to any station due to operational requirements; place of posting can be changed to any location within India at sole discretion of AAICLAS Management.
  • Any canvassing or bringing political/outside influence shall be treated as disqualification.
  • All further announcements/details pertaining to this recruitment will be published only on www.aaiclas.aero and not by post.

BEL  HLS&SCB Recruitment 2026 Overview

BEL is recruiting 56 Field Operation Engineer and Project Engineer-I posts on contractual basis with BE/B.Tech/ME/M.Tech/MCA qualification, last date 08 June 2026.

Organization Name Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL), Homeland Security and Smart City Business SBU (HLS&SCB), Bengaluru Complex

Additional Allowances FOE: Rs. 20,000/- per year (medical insurance, attire, footwear, etc.) | Project Engineer-I: Rs. 12,000/- per year
Contract Duration FOE: Initially 3 years, extendable up to 5 years max | Project Engineer-I: Initially 3 years, extendable up to 4 years max

Application Mode Online only (via Microsoft Office Form link / QR code on BEL website)

Age Calculated As On 01-06-2026

BEL HLS&SCB Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

A total of 56 posts have been announced across two roles - Field Operation Engineer (FOE) and Project Engineer-I - for project sites in Delhi, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh. The number of vacancies is provisional and may be increased or decreased at the management's discretion. Reservation for Persons with Disability (PwBD) and concessions/relaxations for reserved categories will be as per Government of India guidelines.

Post Total
Field Operation Engineer (FOE) 25
Project Engineer-I 31
Total 56

Abbreviations: UR – Unreserved, OBC (NCL) – Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer), EWS – Economically Weaker Section, SC – Scheduled Caste, ST – Scheduled Tribe. PwBD reservation is horizontal within overall vacancies as per Government guidelines.

BEL HLS&SCB Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Only Indian Nationals are eligible. Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on 01-06-2026. Candidates should be willing to be posted at project sites in Delhi, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh and willing to travel across India.

Criteria Details
Nationality Indian Nationals only.
Educational Qualification (as on 01-06-2026) ME/M.Tech/BE/B.Tech/B.Sc Engineering (4-year course) or MCA from AICTE/UGC approved college/institute or recognized university. Pass class for all categories including SC/ST/PwBD.
Eligible Disciplines Electronics / Electronics & Communication / Electronics & Telecommunication / Telecommunication / Communication / Mechanical / Electrical / Electrical & Electronics / Computer Science / Computer Science & Engineering / Computer Engineering / Information Technology / Information Science / MCA. (Note: Discipline on degree certificate must exactly match the advertised specialization.)
CGPA/Credits Conversion Candidates assessed on CGPA/credits system must attach the official university conversion formula from CGPA/credits to percentage. Failure to do so will result in cancellation of candidature.
Experience – Field Operation Engineer 5 years relevant post-qualification work experience in Networking/Data Centres operations/Database administration. Required knowledge: Data networking concepts, DBMS, Firewall, AAA server, Routing protocols (OSPF, BGP), Switching protocols (STP, RSTP, VTP), EtherChannel, NTP, VLAN, Port Security, DNS, CCNA basics, IP addressing & subnetting, Linux basics.
Experience – Project Engineer-I 2 years relevant post-qualification work experience in the same domains as FOE above.
Non-Eligible Experience Teaching/Academic/Research work, experience in banking and financial institutions, non-profit organizations, and internship placements forming part of academic curriculum will NOT be considered as experience.
BEL Employees Trainee Engineers/Project Engineers/FOE/Sr.FOE currently working in BEL must submit a copy of 'Intimation Letter' duly signed by the concerned HR while applying. Lateral application for the same post is not permitted.
PSU / Govt. Employees Must compulsorily submit a 'No Objection Certificate' at the time of application or interview.

BEL HLS&SCB Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

The upper age limit indicated is for candidates belonging to General (UR) and EWS categories, as on 01-06-2026. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India guidelines for reserved categories.

BEL HLS&SCB Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Application fee must be paid through SBI Collect (online mode only) before submitting the application. Candidates applying for more than one post must make separate payments for each post. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Candidates must note the SBI Collect Reference Number generated after payment and enter it in the application form.

BEL HLS&SCB Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection shall be through a Pre-Registered Walk-In Selection to be held in and around Delhi, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh. Venue, date and time will be published on BEL's website careers section and communicated via registered e-mail to shortlisted candidates.

Stage 1 - Written Test (Objective Type)

Component Marks Weightage Details
Written Test 85 marks (85%) Conducted for all shortlisted candidates meeting eligibility criteria.
Interview 15 marks (15%) Only candidates passing the written test are shortlisted for interview in ratio 1:10 (merit and category-wise). Interview scheduled on same day or subsequent days immediately after written test results.

Final selection results will be notified on BEL's official website and offer of engagement sent to selected candidates' registered e-mail ID. A candidate not selected will receive no separate communication.

Stage 2 - Document Verification & Medical Fitness

Selected candidates must produce all original documents for verification and submit proof of medical insurance at the time of joining. FOE candidates: Medical Insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakhs per annum and Life Cover Insurance of Rs. 10 lakhs per annum. Project Engineer candidates: Medical Insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakhs per annum and Life Cover Insurance of Rs. 5 lakhs per annum.

Who should NOT apply for BEL HLS&SCB Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates seeking a permanent/regular government or PSU job; this is strictly a contractual engagement (3 to max 5 years for FOE, 3 to max 4 years for Project Engineer-I) with no guarantee of absorption into BEL.
  • Candidates without the mandatory post-qualification experience (5 years for FOE, 2 years for Project Engineer-I); teaching, academic, research, banking, non-profit, and internship experience are explicitly excluded.
  • Fresh graduates or candidates with less than 2 years of relevant post-qualification industrial experience.
  • Candidates whose degree discipline/specialization does not exactly match the branches listed in the advertisement; mismatched specializations will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates above the upper age limit as on 01-06-2026 (40 years for FOE, 32 years for Project Engineer-I), even by a single day, except those entitled to category-based relaxation.
  • Candidates not willing to be posted at project sites in Delhi, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh or Madhya Pradesh or not willing to travel across India as per project requirements.
  • Candidates who have previously applied for the same post as a lateral application within BEL; lateral applications are not permitted and will be summarily rejected.
  • BEL employees (Trainee/Project Engineers/FOE/Sr.FOE) who have not given prior intimation to their HR department before the application deadline, or who cannot attach the signed Intimation Letter.
  • PSU/Government organization employees who cannot produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of application or interview.
  • Candidates whose CGPA/credits cannot be converted to percentage as per official university norms, or who cannot provide the conversion formula document from their university.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying BEL HLS&SCB Recruitment 2026?

  • Applying without first verifying that your degree discipline/specialization exactly matches one of the listed branches; mismatches lead to rejection at any stage of selection.
  • Entering wrong or inactive e-mail ID or mobile number in the application form; all communications including shortlisting, venue and offer of engagement are sent only to registered e-mail/mobile - BEL is not responsible for bounced or non-received e-mails.
  • Paying application fee through SBI Collect with a different mobile number or e-mail ID than the one entered in the online application form, which can cause payment-application mismatch.
  • Not noting the SBI Collect Reference Number after payment; this must be entered in the application form and is mandatory for processing.
  • Applying in the wrong post category (FOE vs Project Engineer-I) or not paying separate fees for each post when applying for both.
  • OBC candidates belonging to the Creamy Layer applying under OBC (NCL) reservation; only candidates with a valid Non-Creamy Layer OBC certificate issued on or after 01.06.2025 are eligible for OBC reservation benefits.
  • EWS candidates not ensuring their Income & Asset certificate is for the year 2025-26 as required.
  • Not printing and carrying the filled application form with 2 passport-size photographs and all required originals/attested copies to the Walk-In selection venue on the notified day.
  • Counting teaching, research, internship, banking sector, or non-profit experience toward the required post-qualification experience years; these are explicitly excluded and will lead to disqualification at document verification.
  • Registering after the closing date (08-06-2026); candidates who have not registered online will not be allowed to appear for the Walk-In selections under any circumstances.

How to Apply for BEL HLS&SCB Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply online only through the Microsoft Office Form link / QR code provided on the BEL official website. Registrations received in any other format will not be considered. Candidates must first pay the application fee via SBI Collect, note the reference number, and then complete the online form. Applications that are incomplete, not legible, contain false or suppressed information, or do not meet the eligibility criteria will be summarily rejected.

Steps to Fill the Online Application:

  • Go through the detailed advertisement and confirm all eligibility criteria are met before proceeding.
  • Pay the application fee through SBI Collect at the link provided; note the SBI Collect Reference Number.
  • Register online using the Microsoft Office Form link / QR code available on BEL's official website for the respective post.
  • Fill in all mandatory fields including SBI Collect Reference Number and submit the form.
  • After clicking Submit, a copy of the filled application form will be sent to your registered e-mail ID.
  • Print the application form. Carry the printout along with 2 recent passport-size colour photographs and all required documents to the Walk-In selection venue on the intimated date.

Documents Required at the Time of Written Test / Interview / Document Verification:

  • SSLC/SSC/10th standard marks card as proof of date of birth
  • All educational certificates starting from Matriculation/Class X
  • ME/M.Tech/MCA/BE/B.Tech/B.Sc Engineering (4-year course) degree certificate; CGPA/credits conversion formula from university (if applicable) - mandatory, failing which candidature will be cancelled
  • All semester mark sheets / final consolidated mark sheet
  • Caste/Community/Disability/Income certificate for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD/EWS candidates in prescribed Government of India format (OBC NCL certificate issued on or after 01.06.2025; EWS Income & Asset certificate for 2025-26)
  • Post-qualification experience certificate(s) from all previous and current employers; joining/appointment letter, relieving letter and, where current experience certificate is unavailable, first and latest pay slips and employee ID proof
  • 'No Objection Certificate' for candidates working in PSUs/Government organizations
  • 'Intimation Letter' duly signed by concerned HR for candidates currently working in BEL
  • Copy of SBI Collect application fee payment receipt
  • Any document in a language other than Hindi/English must be accompanied by a transcript attested by a gazette officer or notary

Register Online at: https://www.bel-india.in/careers/ or https://belindia.in/careers/

For queries: E-mail: [email protected] | Telephone: 080-22197933

Important Instructions for BEL HLS&SCB Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • THIS IS A TEMPORARY/CONTRACTUAL ENGAGEMENT, NOT REGULAR EMPLOYMENT IN BEL. Candidates engaged will not be treated as regular employees of BEL and will not be entitled to employee benefits. BEL has no obligation to offer regular employment during or after the contract period.

  • No changes to date/time/venue of the written test or interview will be entertained once a candidate is shortlisted/selected.
  • There will be no separate communication to candidates regarding non-selection at any stage.
  • Only Indian Nationals need apply. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • BEL does not demand or charge any fee other than the application fee stated in this advertisement. Candidates are urged not to be misled by fraudsters claiming to represent BEL. BEL will take legal action including criminal action against fraudsters.
  • All revisions/corrigendum, if any, will be hosted on BEL's official website only - candidates should visit regularly.

Balmer Lawrie Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection is made strictly as per merit and following extant reservation rules. All stages — CBT, Document Verification, GD/GT (if any), Personal Interview, and Medical Test — are mandatory for final engagement. Candidates must secure minimum qualifying cut-off scores at each stage to be considered for the final merit list. The date, time and venue of all stages will be intimated to eligible candidates in due course through the official website and/or email. No request for postponement of any selection process or change of venue, date or shift will be entertained.

Stage 1 - Computer Based Test (CBT)

Section Contents Max. Marks Cut-off (UR/EWS/OBC) Cut-off (SC/ST/PwBD)
Section 1 Graduate Engineering posts: MCQ on General Engineering (generic, covering common Engineering subjects irrespective of disciplines)
MBA (Equivalent) posts: MCQ on General Management (covering common Management subjects irrespective of disciplines)		 40 24 (60%) 22 (55%)
Section 2 MCQ on Aptitude – Logical Reasoning, Data Interpretation, Quantitative Aptitude and English Proficiency (Common for both Graduate Engineering and MBA posts) 60 Nil Nil
Total 100 65 60

CBT consists of 100 MCQ objective-type questions of 1 mark each; duration 90 minutes (120 minutes for eligible PwBD candidates). Negative marking: 1/4th of marks allotted for each question deducted for each wrong answer. Question paper set in English & Hindi; in case of discrepancy, English version shall prevail. Examinations for all positions shall be conducted on the same day and time — therefore, one candidate should apply against ONE post only. CBT score will be used only for shortlisting for the next stage; obtaining minimum qualifying marks does not confer any right to be shortlisted as selection depends on merit rank in community-based CBT merit list. Total candidates shortlisted for DV: 5–10 times the community-wise vacancies as per merit.

Stage 2 - Document Verification (DV)

Candidates qualifying in CBT will be called for Document Verification in order of community-wise CBT merit. Eligibility verification including age, qualification, caste/category certificates and all other documents will be done at this stage. Candidates must produce all original documents; failure to do so will result in cancellation of candidature.

Stage 3 - Group Discussion (GD) / Group Task (GT) — if any

Balmer Lawrie may, at its discretion, hold or not hold GD/GT for any or all posts. If held, appearance is mandatory and qualifying in nature. Minimum qualifying cut-off: 65% for UR/EWS/OBC/Others; 60% for SC/ST/PwBD.

Stage 4 - Personal Interview (PI)

Candidates clearing CBT, DV, and GD/GT (if any) will be called for Personal Interview (mandatory, qualifying in nature). Minimum qualifying cut-off: 65% for UR/EWS/OBC/Others; 60% for SC/ST/PwBD. PI may be conducted at Company Head Office, Kolkata or any other location as decided by the Company.

Stage 5 - Medical Test

Engagement as Executive Trainee is subject to being declared medically fit by Company's doctor or an approved medical practitioner. Pre-engagement medical checkup shall be undertaken at the Model Hospital of the Region/Company nominated Medical Center or a Government Hospital. Actual charges for medical checkup shall be reimbursed by the Company at the time of joining.

Final Merit List Weightage:

In case of CBT & Interview only: CBT 75% + PI 25%. In case of CBT + GD + Interview: CBT 65% + GD 15% + PI 20%. Tie-breaking: Date of Birth (eldest first), then alphabetical order of name (A to Z).

Competition Level Analysis for Balmer Lawrie Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026

The competition level for Balmer Lawrie ET Recruitment 2026 is expected to be very high given that only 62 posts are on offer across 12 position codes from a large national pool of engineering graduates and MBA postgraduates. Being a Mini Ratna I Government of India enterprise with a 160-year legacy, Balmer Lawrie attracts serious aspirants from IITs, NITs, and top management institutes. The CBT, covering general engineering or general management concepts along with aptitude, is accessible to a broad candidate base, which further amplifies competition.

The real filter comes at the Personal Interview stage, where domain knowledge, company awareness across Balmer Lawrie's diverse SBUs (Greases & Lubricants, Industrial Packaging, Cold Chain, Logistics, Travel & Vacations, Chemicals), and communication skills are assessed. Candidates should note that all 12 positions are tested on the same day at the same time — meaning you can apply for only one post. Choosing the right post aligned with your strongest qualification and SBU interest is therefore a critical strategic decision before applying.

Who should NOT apply for Balmer Lawrie Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not possess the exact B.E./B.Tech or MBA (Equivalent) qualification in the specific discipline/specialization prescribed for the post they intend to apply for.
  • Candidates who have scored less than 65% (or 60% for SC/ST/PwBD) in their qualifying degree; rounding off of 59.99% to 60% is not permitted.
  • Candidates exceeding the maximum age limit of 25 years (Graduate Engineering posts) or 27 years (MBA posts) as on 09-06-2026, except as per applicable category relaxations.
  • Candidates who have completed their engineering degree through ODL/Distance/Part-time/Correspondence mode (engineering via ODL is not accepted, except IGNOU B.Tech enrolled up to 2011-12).
  • Candidates who have completed their MBA/Management degree through ODL/Distance/Correspondence mode without AICTE recognition for that specific ODL programme.
  • OBC candidates belonging to the Creamy Layer; they must apply as UR candidates. OBC-NCL certificate must be valid as on the closing date of application.
  • PwBD candidates whose disability is less than 40%; minimum 40% permanent disability is required to avail PwBD benefits.
  • Candidates unwilling to work on shifts, be posted/transferred to any location in India or abroad (subsidiaries/joint ventures of Balmer Lawrie), or work at any of the Company's establishments as per business requirements.
  • Candidates who wish to apply for more than one post; only one application per candidate is permitted as all examinations are conducted on the same day and time.
  • Government/Semi-Government/PSU/Autonomous Body employees who cannot produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their present employer at the time of Document Verification.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying Balmer Lawrie Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026?

  • Applying for a post whose discipline/specialization does not exactly match your degree — e.g., applying for ET (Mechanical) with a Civil Engineering degree, or ET (Sales & Marketing) with a Finance specialization.
  • Applying for more than one position; all exams are held simultaneously and in case of multiple applications, only the latest one will be retained and earlier fees forfeited.
  • Entering cumulative aggregate percentage below the threshold (65%/60%) or attempting to round off marks; 59.99% will be treated as below 60% without exception.
  • Not checking whether your university/institute is recognized/approved by UGC/AICTE/relevant statutory authority; courses from unrecognized institutes will not be accepted.
  • OBC candidates applying without a valid, current Non-Creamy Layer certificate; OBC-NCL certificate must be valid as on the date of application.
  • EWS candidates applying without a valid Income and Asset Certificate valid as on the date of document verification.
  • Uploading photographs older than 3 weeks, blurred signatures, or certificates not clearly visible in the scanned file; this can lead to rejection at scrutiny stage.
  • Using an inactive mobile number or email ID, causing missed communications on CBT admit card, DV call letter, GD/GT/PI intimation, or offer letter.
  • Refreshing or going back on the page during fee payment, which can interfere with the ongoing transaction and result in application remaining incomplete.
  • Submitting application without verifying all details carefully; once the application is submitted, no changes/edits will be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Bringing banned items (calculator, mobile phone, smartwatch, Bluetooth, pen drive, digital watch, bangles, metallic wears, etc.) to the CBT centre; possession of any banned item will lead to immediate cancellation of candidature.

How to Apply for Balmer Lawrie Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply online only through https://www.balmerlawrie.com/careers/current-openings. No other mode of application will be accepted. No documents are required to be sent to Balmer Lawrie by post. The online application process involves two steps: Step 1 – Registration and Step 2 – Filling up of Application and Submission of Fee. Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date and not wait till the last day.

Documents Required to be Scanned and Uploaded:

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (not older than 3 weeks; light-coloured/white background; 40 KB–100 KB; JPG/JPEG; minimum 200 DPI)
  • Signature on white paper with Blue/Black ink pen (20 KB–50 KB; JPG/JPEG) — must be in running hand, not block/capital or disjointed letters
  • Relevant Qualification Certificates (Essential Qualification Degree/Diploma Certificates; 100 KB–300 KB; PDF)
  • Caste/Category Certificate — SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/Disability/Ex-SM as applicable (100 KB–300 KB; PDF), issued by Competent Authority in the prescribed Central Government format
  • Discharge Certificate (Retirement) in case of Ex-Servicemen candidates

Documents to be Produced at the time of Document Verification (original + self-attested copy):

  • Valid Birth Certificate / School Leaving Certificate / Matriculation / Secondary (10th) Examination Certificate or Marksheet for verification of Date of Birth
  • Final Certificate and Marksheets of all semesters/years of qualifying course (B.E./B.Tech or MBA/equivalent); consolidated marksheet covering all semesters if available
  • CGPA/GPA percentage conversion formula letter from Head of Institute/Controller of Examination (if percentage is not mentioned in marksheet)
  • SC/ST Caste Certificate in prescribed Government of India format issued by Competent Authority (as per Annexure-I(A))
  • OBC-NCL Certificate in prescribed Central Government format with Non-Creamy Layer clause, valid as on the date of Document Verification (as per Annexure-I(B))
  • Income and Asset Certificate in prescribed format for EWS, valid as on the date of Document Verification (as per Annexure-I(C))
  • Disability Certificate in prescribed form (Form V/VI/VII) issued by Competent Authority (for PwBD candidates; as per Annexure-II(A), II(B), II(C))
  • For Ex-Servicemen: Discharge Certificate/NOC from Competent Authority; Serving Defence Personnel Certificate (Annexure-I(D)) if applicable; Undertaking as per Annexure-I(E)
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from present employer in original (for candidates employed in Government/Semi-Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies)
  • Five coloured Passport Size latest Photographs; Aadhaar Card; PAN Card (or acknowledgement receipt if not yet allotted)
  • Print-out of e-Admit Card issued for CBT; any other certificate as specified

Apply Online at: https://www.balmerlawrie.com/careers/current-openings

For queries: Helpdesk Tab in online Application Portal or call 08064526227 (10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, except Saturdays, Sundays and Holidays) from 19-05-2026 to 11-06-2026.

Important Instructions for Balmer Lawrie Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Examinations for all positions are conducted on the same day and at the same time; one candidate must apply against one post only. In case of multiple applications, only the latest one shall be considered as final and earlier applications will be rejected without notice.
  • The nature of engagement and training is hands-on, on-job basis; trainees may need to report on shifts. They may be located at or transferred to any of the operations/establishments of the Company in India or abroad.
  • The process of registration will be complete only when the prescribed application fee is deposited through online mode on or before 11-06-2026; incomplete applications due to non-receipt of fee will be summarily rejected.
  • Final year candidates will also be considered provided they submit their final marksheet and join by 08-02-2027; they must upload marksheets of all semesters/years cleared to establish they are in the final year as on the last date of application.
  • All candidates, irrespective of community, may be considered against UR vacancies subject to fulfilling UR parameters and not availing reserved category relaxations. Against vacancies earmarked for specific communities, only candidates belonging to that community will be considered.
  • Obtaining minimum qualifying marks in CBT does not confer any right for being shortlisted for the next stage; shortlisting depends on merit rank in the community-based CBT merit list and the ratio approved by Balmer Lawrie.
  • Provisional Answer Keys will be displayed on the Balmer Lawrie website after CBT; objections can be submitted online within the stipulated time on payment of Rs. 100/- plus applicable charges per question. Objections through any other mode (letter, email, etc.) will not be entertained.
  • Candidates must carry the printed e-Admit Card and one valid original photo ID (Voter's ID, Driving License, Aadhaar Card, Passport, PAN, or any other Government-issued ID) to the CBT centre; absence of either will result in denial of entry.
  • Candidates must report to the CBT centre at least one and a half hours before commencement; entry gates will be closed half an hour before the exam and no entry will be allowed after gate closure.
  • SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen outstation candidates appearing for CBT are entitled to Sleeper Class to-and-fro rail fare reimbursement on production of self-attested original journey tickets; local conveyance will not be reimbursed. All outstation candidates shortlisted for GD/GT or PI are also entitled to Sleeper Class rail fare reimbursement.
  • All further information/corrigendum/results/notices shall be posted only on the Careers section of the official website of Balmer Lawrie; no separate notification shall be issued in the print media.
  • Selected candidates will be on training-cum-probation for one year from the date of joining; absorption and confirmation is subject to satisfactory completion. Training-cum-probation can be terminated or extended on merits of individual cases.
  • Canvassing in any form or influencing officials by any means will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Any dispute with regard to this recruitment shall be settled within the jurisdiction of Kolkata Court only.
  • Beware of fake websites and touts offering job in Balmer Lawrie through influence or unfair means; the recruitment process is absolutely transparent and merit-based. Consult only the official website https://www.balmerlawrie.com.

Bank of Baroda Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Get the latest BOB recruitment notification 2026 for 5000 Apprentice vacancies under the Apprentices Act, 1961. The online application process starts on 19th May 2026 and the last date to apply online is 8th June 2026. Find Bank of Baroda Apprentice vacancies across all States/UTs on the official website http://bankofbaroda.bank.in. You can also get OnlyJobs of "Upcoming Bank of Baroda Apprentice Recruitment 2026" notifications for freshers and experienced candidates. Also know the direct official link for BOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026 apply online from the Bank of Baroda career page.

FOLLOW US

Bank of Baroda Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Bank of Baroda has officially released Advertisement No. BOB/HRM/APPRENTICE/ADVT/2026/01 dated 19/05/2026 for engagement of 5000 Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended from time to time). The notification includes complete details on training seats, eligibility, selection process, State/UT-wise vacancy breakup, PwBD reservation, application fee, and application instructions. Candidates are strongly advised to download and read the full notification before applying. The notification PDF is available on the official Bank of Baroda website and BFSI SSC's website.

  • Download Bank of Baroda Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF

Bank of Baroda Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Overview

BOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

A total of 5000 training seats have been announced for engagement as Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961. These are distributed State/UT-wise across SC, ST, OBC, EWS, and UR categories with horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD). The number of training seats is provisional and may vary according to the actual requirement of the Bank.

BOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the cut-off date (01-05-2026). Candidates must be registered on Government Apprenticeship Portals (NATS and/or NAPS) before applying. Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply.

Criteria Details
Registration Requirement Candidates must be registered on NAPS portal (https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) and/or NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) before applying.
Educational Qualification Graduation Degree in any Discipline from a recognized University or any equivalent qualifications recognized by the Central Government. For NATS candidates: date of passing Graduation should not be more than 4 years preceding 01-05-2026.
Prior Apprenticeship Candidate should NOT have undergone Apprenticeship with Bank of Baroda or any other Establishment in the past, and should not currently be pursuing Apprenticeship Training with any Establishment.
Training / Job Experience Candidates who had training or job experience for a period of 1 year or more after completing educational qualification shall NOT be eligible.
State/UT Application Candidates can apply for engagement as apprentice in one State/UT only and must select up to 3 preferred training locations/centres from those notified within that State/UT.
Nationality Indian Citizens only.

BOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates must be a minimum of 20 years and maximum of 28 years of age as on the cut-off date (01-05-2026). Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India guidelines for reserved categories, subject to the condition that NAPS-registered candidates should be below 34 years as on 01-05-2026.

BOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates are required to pay non-refundable Application/Intimation/Examination Charges/Fees to BFSI SSC through the secure payment link provided in the application form. The fee must be paid through ONLINE mode only. No other mode of payment will be accepted. Fee once paid will NOT be refunded on any account.

General / EWS / OBC – Female / Transgender Candidates Rs. 600/- plus GST

BOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection for engagement of apprentices will be based on three stages - Online Examination, Document Verification, and Test of local language of the State. Candidates must qualify all three stages. Final selection is subject to medical fitness as per the Bank's requirements. A State-wise and Category-wise Wait List will be published for vacancies arising from non-acceptance or non-reporting by selected candidates; this wait list remains valid for 1 year from result declaration or until the next engagement exercise, whichever is earlier.

Stage 1 - Online Examination

S No Name of Test No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration Medium of Test

4 General English 25 25 English
Total 100 100  

There will be NO negative marks for wrong answers. The online examination will be remotely proctored - candidates can appear from any location of their choice using a smart mobile phone / laptop / desktop / tablet with an operational front camera, microphone, and stable Wi-Fi internet connection. SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates get 5% relaxation in minimum qualifying marks on aggregate. Merit list will be drawn State-wise and Category-wise in descending order of aggregate marks. Tie-break: higher age is preferred.

Stage 2 - Document Verification

Candidates qualifying the online examination will be called for Document Verification at a Bank-designated centre of the State/UT applied for, at their own expense. Bank of Baroda will not reimburse travelling expenses for Document Verification.
