How to Apply for Bank of Baroda Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only. No other mode of application will be accepted. Candidates must first mandatorily register themselves on the Government Apprenticeship portals - NATS (https://nats.education.gov.in) and/or NAPS (https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in).

After completing registration on NAPS/NATS, eligible candidates will receive an email from [email protected] inviting them to fill the final "Application cum Examination Form" and make payment of the applicable fee/charges.

The application registration is considered complete only when fee/charges are deposited with BFSI SSC. Candidates must note down their Enrolment Id (NATS portal) and Apprentice Registration Code (NAPS portal) for all future correspondence.

Documents Required for Registration on NATS/NAPS Portals:

  • Colour scan copy of Aadhaar Card – Front & Back Page (JPEG, <1 MB)
  • Colour scan copy of PAN Card (JPEG, <1 MB)
  • Valid Personal Email ID and Mobile Number
  • Colour scan copy of Passport-size Photograph (JPEG, <1 MB)
  • Colour scan copy of Xth Marksheet (PDF, <1 MB)
  • Colour scan copy of XIIth Marksheet (PDF, <1 MB)
  • Colour scan copy of Degree Marksheet / Provisional Certificate (PDF, <1 MB)
  • Colour scan copy of Saving Bank Passbook / Cheque Leaf (PDF, <1 MB)
  • Colour scan copy of Signature (JPEG, <1 MB)

Documents to be Produced at the time of Document Verification / Language Proficiency Test:

  • Printout of valid Language Proficiency Test Intimation Letter/mail from Bank
  • Valid system generated printout of the online application / Registration / Enrollment form
  • Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate from Competent Municipal Authority or SSLC / Std. X Certificate with DOB)
  • Photo Identity Proof (Government-issued ID)
  • Individual Semester/Year-wise Marksheets and Certificates for educational qualifications including final degree/diploma certificate
  • CGPA to Percentage conversion certificate (if grades awarded), issued by the appropriate authority
  • Caste Certificate in prescribed Government of India format (for SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates) - OBC-NCL certificate must be issued within one year as on date of advertisement
  • Disability Certificate in prescribed format issued by District Medical Board (for PwBD candidates)
  • Any other relevant documents in support of eligibility

Documents to be produced at the venue of Document Verification / Language Test. Non-submission of requisite documents will debar candidature from further participation in the selection process. Candidates must appear at their own expense.

Apply Online at: https://bankofbaroda.bank.in/ and https://bfsissc.com

Important Instructions for Bank of Baroda Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • This is NOT regular employment or contract employment in the Bank. Apprentices will be TRAINEES only and not employees of Bank of Baroda.
  • The apprentice shall have no right to claim employment in the Bank after completion of training. Bank of Baroda has no obligation to offer regular employment to apprentices during or after the apprenticeship period.
  • Candidates can apply for engagement as apprentice in one State/UT only. Allotment to a different State/UT will not be considered under any circumstances.
  • Candidates must first register on NATS and/or NAPS portals before applying; application without portal registration is not valid.
  • The process of registration is complete only when applicable fee/charges are deposited with BFSI SSC.
  • No Ex-servicemen / Disabled Ex-Servicemen shall be engaged as an apprentice; there is no reservation for Ex-servicemen in this engagement.
  • OBC candidates belonging to the 'Creamy Layer' are not entitled to OBC reservation and age relaxation; they should apply as General / General (OC/HI/VI/ID) as applicable.
  • Change of category once submitted in the online application will not be permitted at any stage.
  • Candidates should submit only one application; in case of multiple submissions, only the last valid completed application will be considered and fee paid for earlier registrations will be forfeited.
  • The Apprentices are prohibited from joining / forming any Union Body.
  • All correspondence will be made only on the registered email ID; candidates should keep it active throughout the recruitment process. No hard copy intimation will be sent by post for Online Examination.
  • Candidates must appear for the selection process (Document Verification, Language Test) at their own cost; Bank will not reimburse travelling expenses.
  • Apprentices will not be provided with Transport / Hostel facility or any other residential accommodation during training.
  • Stipend of Rs. 15,000/- per month will be paid on completion of each month after adjusting Loss of Pay, if any. No other allowances/benefits are payable.
  • All amendments/corrigendum (if any) will be published only on the Bank's website (https://bankofbaroda.bank.in/) and https://bfsissc.com - candidates should visit regularly.
  • Any canvassing directly or indirectly shall disqualify the candidature. Use of unfair means, impersonation, or misbehavior will lead to disqualification and/or debarment.
  • Legal jurisdiction for any dispute arising out of this recruitment shall be Mumbai only.

How to Apply for Sarkari Job Online 2026

  1. Find the right Sarkari Job: Use the vacancy table or sector links above on OnlyJobs. Filter by your qualification — 10th, 12th, Graduate, or Engineering. Check the last date and eligibility carefully.

  2. Read the official notification: Click on the job listing to open the official notification PDF. Read all eligibility conditions — age limit, educational qualification, experience, category relaxations.

  3. Visit the official recruitment website: Never apply through third-party sites. Use the direct official link provided on OnlyJobs. Look for "Apply Online" or "Register" on the official portal.

  4. Register / Create account: Sign up using your valid email ID and active mobile number. Keep your Aadhaar, bank account details, and email accessible.

  5. Fill the application form: Enter personal details, educational qualifications, category (General/OBC/SC/ST/EWS), address, and other required information accurately.

  6. Upload documents: Scan and upload recent passport-size photograph, signature, 10th certificate (for DOB proof), educational certificates, caste certificate (if applicable). Check file size and format (JPG/PDF as specified).

  7. Pay application fee: Pay via Net Banking, UPI, Debit/Credit Card as applicable. Some categories (SC/ST/PwD/Women) may be exempted from fee. Keep the payment receipt.

  8. Submit and save confirmation: Review all details before final submission. After submitting, download the application printout / PDF confirmation with your registration number. Store it safely for admit card, exam, and future reference.

Job Security

7th Pay Commission Salary

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Forest Department Posts List

Forest departments work with a clear hierarchy from senior Indian Forest Service officers to field-level staff like Forest Guard and Forest Watcher. Understanding these posts helps candidates know growth opportunities and career progression in forest services.

  • Principal Chief Conservator of Forests (PCCF) / Head of Forest Force
  • Additional Principal Chief Conservator of Forests (APCCF) / Additional Chief Conservator of Forests
  • Chief Conservator of Forests (CCF)
  • Conservator of Forests (CF)
  • Deputy Conservator of Forests (DCF) / Divisional Forest Officer (DFO)
  • Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF)
  • Forest Range Officer (FRO) / Range Forest Officer (RFO)
  • Deputy Forest Ranger / Forest Inspector
  • Section Forest Officer / Forester / Van Daroga
  • Beat Forest Officer / Beat Guard / Forester Grade I
  • Forest Guard / Van Rakshak
  • Forest Watcher / Forest Worker / Plantation Worker
  • Forest Ranger (in states where used separately)
  • Field Guard

Most forest department recruitment notifications on this page focus on Forest Guard, Forester, Forest Range Officer, Field Guard and similar Group B, C and D posts.

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs

Eligibility for forest department jobs depends on the post, state and recruitment authority. Below is a general idea of qualification and age for popular posts like Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer. Candidates should always check the official notification for detailed eligibility criteria.

Education Qualification for Forest Guard, Forester, Ranger

  • Forest Guard / Field Guard / Forest Watcher / Beat Guard: Usually 10th pass or 12th pass from a recognized board, knowledge of local language, and basic physical standards as per state rules.
  • Forester / Section Forest Officer / Deputy Forest Ranger: Generally 12th pass or graduate in any stream or science-related subjects, with physical standards and sometimes driving or technical skills depending on the post.
  • Forest Range Officer (RFO) / Forest Ranger / ACF: Normally graduate degree in Science, Agriculture, Forestry, Environmental Science, Engineering or related disciplines, with higher physical standards and sometimes a competitive exam similar to state PCS level.
  • IFS / Indian Forest Service and senior posts (DCF, CF, CCF, PCCF): Filled through UPSC Indian Forest Service Examination and promotions, requiring a graduate degree and all-India competitive selection.

Age Limit & Relaxation

  • Forest Guard / Forester / Field Guard: Minimum age is usually 18 years and maximum age is around 27–30 years, with age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, EWS, Ex-servicemen and other categories as per government rules.
  • Forest Range Officer / ACF and higher competitive posts: Age limit often ranges from 21 to 32 years (varies by recruitment), with relaxations for reserved categories.
  • Exact age limit, cut-off date and relaxation details always depend on the particular notification, so candidates should verify from the official advertisement before applying.

Forest Department Jobs Salary Overview

Forest department salary depends on the post, pay level, state and allowances. Senior officers under Indian Forest Service receive higher pay levels, while Forest Guard, Forester and similar posts fall under state government pay matrices.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern

The selection process for Forest Department Jobs 2026 typically includes written examinations, physical tests and document verification. Some posts also conduct medical examination and walking tests due to the demanding nature of field duties.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  • Written Exam: Most Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer recruitments start with a written exam based on objective-type questions (MCQs).
  • PET / PST (Physical Efficiency Test / Physical Standard Test): Candidates who qualify written exam are called for running, walking test, height, chest measurement and other physical parameters as per post and gender.
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates of age, qualification, caste, residence, sports/NCC and other documents mentioned in the notification.
  • Medical Examination: Many forest posts require medical fitness to ensure candidates can perform field duties in forests, wildlife areas and difficult terrain.

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

Typical syllabus for written exam may include:

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs (national, state-level, environment and forest-related topics)
  • General Hindi / English or regional language (grammar, comprehension, vocabulary)
  • General Mathematics / Quantitative Aptitude (up to 10th or 12th level)
  • General Science and Environmental Studies (forest, wildlife, biodiversity, conservation, climate, basic biology)
  • Reasoning Ability (logical and analytical reasoning)

Exact subject-wise marks, number of questions, negative marking and exam duration will be given in the respective forest department notification.

How to Apply for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Most Forest Department Jobs 2026 applications are accepted either online through official websites or offline via prescribed application forms. Candidates should carefully read the official notification before filling the form.

Online Application Process

  1. Visit the official website of the recruiting body (State Forest Department, State PSC, Staff Selection Board or other government portal).
  2. Find the latest link for Forest Guard / Forester / Forest Range Officer / other forest posts and open the detailed advertisement.
  3. Complete the registration process with basic details like name, mobile number, email ID and verify using OTP if required.
  4. Fill the online application form with personal, educational, address and category information exactly as per documents.
  5. Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature and other certificates in the prescribed format and size.
  6. Pay the application fee online through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI as per your convenience.
  7. Finally, submit the form and take a printout or PDF of the submitted application and payment receipt for future reference.

Documents Required & Application Fee

  • Recent passport size photograph and signature (scanned)
  • Class 10th and 12th mark sheets and certificates
  • Degree / Diploma certificates for graduate-level posts
  • Caste / Category certificate (SC, ST, OBC, EWS, etc.)
  • Domicile / Residence certificate if required by the state
  • NCC, Sports, Ex-serviceman and other quota certificates if applicable
  • Valid ID proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, Passport, etc.)

Why Choose Forest Department Jobs?

Forest department jobs are popular among candidates who love nature, wildlife and field work. These jobs offer job security, government benefits and a chance to work in forest conservation, wildlife protection, eco-tourism and community development.

  • Stable government job with regular salary, pension/NPS and allowances
  • Opportunity to work in forests, wildlife sanctuaries, national parks and protected areas
  • Contribution to environment protection, afforestation and biodiversity conservation
  • Good promotion avenues from Forest Guard to Forester, Forest Range Officer and higher posts in many states.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has published Advertisement No. 04/2026 inviting online recruitment applications (ORA) for direct recruitment by selection to various prestigious Group ‘A’ and Group ‘B’ Gazetted posts under different Ministries and Departments of the Government of India. Applications are invited from eligible Indian citizens for filling up these posts on a permanent basis. Interested and eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the UPSC website https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/. The last date for submission of online applications is 29th May 2026 (18:00 Hrs). Candidates are strongly advised to read the complete advertisement carefully, including all instructions, before filling the online application form.

FOLLOW US

UPSC Advertisement No. 04/2026 Recruitment Notification PDF

Union Public Service Commission has released detailed Advertisement No. 04/2026 dated 08.05.2026 for recruitment to multiple posts including Assistant Library & Information Officer, Associate Professor, Assistant Professors in various engineering disciplines, Translators (Chinese & Tibetan), Senior Administrative Officers in DRDO, Assistant Mining Engineers, Assistant Research Officers, and Accounts Officers. The notification provides complete details on vacancies, reservation, pay scales, age limits, essential/desirable qualifications, experience, duties, probation, headquarters, and other conditions. All candidates are advised to download and thoroughly read the full official notification along with the instructions before applying online.

  • Download UPSC Advertisement No. 04/2026 Official Notification PDF

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Overview

Organization Name Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
Advertisement No. 04/2026
Post Name Various Group ‘A’ & Group ‘B’ Gazetted Posts
Total Vacancies Multiple Posts (Detailed Below)
Application Mode Online Only (through UPSC ORA Portal)
Selection Process Shortlisting (based on qualifications/experience/Recruitment Test) + Interview
Official Website https://www.upsc.gov.in & https://upsconline.nic.in

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Starting Date for Online Application 09.05.2026
Last Date for Submission of Online Application 29.05.2026 (18:00 Hrs)
Date for Determining Eligibility 29.05.2026

UPSC Vacancy Details 2026

UPSC has announced multiple vacancies across various Ministries/Departments. The detailed vacancy position is as under:

Post Name & Organization Reservation Pay Scale Age Limit
Assistant Library & Information Officer (Language – Kannada), Central Secretariat Library, Ministry of Culture UR-01 (PwBD-01) Level-07 30 years (relaxable upto 10 years for PwBD)
Associate Professor, Civil Engineering (Structural), College of Military Engineering, Pune, Ministry of Defence UR-01 Academic Level 13A1 45 years
Assistant Professor, Civil Engineering (Structural), College of Military Engineering, Pune EWS-01 Academic Level 10 35 years
Assistant Professor, Electrical Engineering (Power System), College of Military Engineering, Pune SC-01 Academic Level 10 40 years
Assistant Professor, Mechanical Engineering (Heat Transfer), College of Military Engineering, Pune UR-01 Academic Level 10 35 years
Translator (Chinese), Signal Intelligence Directorate, Integrated Defence Staff HQ, Ministry of Defence OBC-01 (Suitable for PwBD) Level-10 38 years
Translator (Tibetan), Signal Intelligence Directorate, Integrated Defence Staff HQ, Ministry of Defence UR-01 (Suitable for PwBD) Level-10 35 years
Senior Administrative Officer Grade-II, DRDO, Ministry of Defence UR-11, EWS-03, OBC-08, SC-04, ST-03 (PwBD-01) Level-10 35/38/40 years (category-wise)
Assistant Mining Engineer, Indian Bureau of Mines, Ministry of Mines UR-02, OBC-02 (PwBD-01) Level-07 30/33 years
Assistant Research Officer, Indian Bureau of Mines, Ministry of Mines UR-01, OBC-01 (Suitable for PwBD) Level-07 30/33 years
Accounts Officer, Finance Department, Administration of UT of Ladakh ST-03 (Suitable for PwBD) Level-08 40 years (Ladakh Domicile required)

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill the essential educational qualifications and experience as mentioned against each post. Detailed qualifications are available in the official notification. Qualifications are relaxable at the discretion of UPSC for otherwise well-qualified candidates.

Key Highlights:

  • Engineering Faculty Posts require B.E./B.Tech + M.E./M.Tech with first class in relevant discipline.
  • Translator Posts require Bachelor’s Degree in the concerned foreign language or equivalent diploma with English.
  • Administrative & Other Posts require Bachelor’s Degree with relevant experience.
  • PwBD candidates must meet the specified disability criteria.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit & Relaxation

Category Age Relaxation
UR/EWS As per post (30-45 years)
OBC 3 years
SC/ST 5 years
PwBD Up to 10 years (additional as per category)

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

  • For all Candidates: Rs. 25/-
  • For SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates: NIL

Details of application fee will be available in the online application portal. Candidates are advised to check the instructions while filling the form. Fee exemption is applicable as per UPSC rules for SC/ST/PwBD/Female candidates (wherever notified).

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Selection will be made on the basis of: - Shortlisting based on essential/desirable qualifications and experience. - Recruitment Test (if conducted). - Personal Interview.
  • Final merit list will be prepared after the interview. Minimum qualifying marks apply for each category.

How to Apply for UPSC Advertisement No. 04/2026

Candidates must apply online only using the UPSC ORA portal: https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/. - First register/create profile (URN). - Fill Common Application Form (CAF). - Fill post-specific module. - Upload required documents, photograph, and signature. - Pay fee (if applicable) and submit.

Documents to be Uploaded:

  • Educational certificates, experience certificates, caste/PwBD certificates, etc. in PDF format.

Prerequisites Before Starting the Application

Before logging into the portal, ensure you have the following ready:

  1. Valid Email ID and Mobile Number – These will be used for all future communication and OTP verification.
  2. Scanned Documents (in PDF format, preferably under 1 MB each):
    • Recent passport-size photograph
    • Signature
    • Matriculation/10th certificate (for Date of Birth proof)
    • All educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
    • Experience certificates (if applicable)
    • Caste/Category certificate (OBC/EWS/SC/ST)
    • PwBD certificate (if applicable)
    • Any other supporting documents mentioned in the notification
  3. Details of all educational qualifications and experience chronologically.
  4. Credit/Debit Card or Net Banking details for payment of application fee (if applicable).
  5. Aadhaar Number (recommended for easier registration).

Important Instructions for UPSC Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Applications received after the closing date or incomplete in any respect will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates must upload clear scanned copies of all supporting documents.
  • Date of birth mentioned in Matriculation certificate will be considered final.

Selection will comprise a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview. Candidates shortlisted based on performance in the Written Test will be called for Personal Interview. Part Description Marks Duration

The Written Test is a Professional Knowledge - Subjective paper. There is no negative marking. Though the duration of the examination is 2 hours 30 minutes, candidates may be required to be at the venue for about 4 hours including time for verification and completion of various formalities. Candidates reporting late after the reporting time specified on the call letter will not be permitted to take the examination.

Competition Level Analysis for Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026

The competition level for Exim Bank MT Recruitment 2026 is expected to be very intense given that only 05 vacancies are on offer across two disciplines from a large pool of MBA/PGDBM graduates across India. The Bank being a premier financial institution under the Government of India makes this an exceptionally sought-after position among finance, HR, and administration postgraduates. The subjective Written Test format — unlike the MCQ-based bank exams — demands strong subject knowledge, analytical writing ability, and command over HR / Administration concepts rather than just speed and aptitude.

The low vacancy count means even marginal differences in written test scores will determine shortlisting for the interview round. Candidates with domain depth in HRM/Personnel Management (for MT-HRM) or Hotel/Facilities/Civil background with MBA (for MT-Administration) are better positioned. The Personal Interview carrying 30% of the final weightage means soft skills, subject clarity, and awareness of Exim Bank's functions and India's international trade ecosystem will be critical differentiators at the final stage.

Who should NOT apply for Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who have completed their graduation or postgraduation through correspondence / part-time / open university / open learning / external / distance learning; they are categorically not eligible.
  • Candidates who do not hold a Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) in the relevant specialization with minimum 60% marks in both graduation and post graduation.
  • Candidates outside the age band of 21-28 years as on 30-04-2026 (except as per OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen relaxation).
  • OBC candidates belonging to the Creamy Layer; they must apply as General candidates. OBC certificate must be valid as on the last date of applying (issued within one year prior to the last date).
  • Candidates who have defaulted in any loan repayment and/or whose name appears in CIBIL database as a defaulter.
  • Candidates unwilling to serve anywhere in India or unwilling to be transferred to offices outside India (with consent).
  • Candidates unwilling to execute a personal bond of Rs. 3 lakh to serve the Bank for 1 year as MT and minimum 5 years as employee after absorption.
  • Currently serving employees of Government / PSU who cannot produce a proper Relieving Letter/Discharge Certificate from their present employer at the time of joining.
  • Candidates whose CGPA-based qualification does not include an equivalent percentage conversion letter from the Head of Institute/Controller of Examination (if percentage is not mentioned in marksheet).

Common mistakes / What to check before applying Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?

  • Applying for MT-HRM without specialization in Human Resource Management / Personnel Management, or applying for MT-Administration without the prescribed qualification combinations.
  • Not checking whether your graduation and postgraduation are from a full-time regular programme; part-time/distance mode graduates are not eligible even if the university is recognized.
  • Entering less than 60% marks in either graduation or postgraduation; both must independently meet the 60% threshold.
  • OBC candidates applying with an expired caste certificate; OBC NCL certificate must be issued within one year prior to the last date of applying and must contain the non-creamy layer clause.
  • Uploading blurred/incorrect photo, signature, left thumb impression, or handwritten declaration; any mismatch or unclear document can lead to rejection.
  • Writing the handwritten declaration in capital letters or in a language other than English; both will render the application invalid.
  • Using an inactive or incorrect mobile number/email ID, causing missed notifications for call letters, exam updates, or interview communication.
  • Pressing the BACK or REFRESH button during the online payment process, which may result in double charge or payment failure.
  • Not noting down the Provisional Registration Number and Password generated at the time of registration; required for re-login if application is saved midway.
  • Submitting application without verifying that the name as filled in the form exactly matches the name on photo identity proof; any mismatch will lead to disqualification at the exam/interview stage.

IRCTC Hospitality Monitor Recruitment 2026 - Scope of Work

Selected Hospitality Monitors will be responsible for a range of supervisory and monitoring duties across mobile/static catering units operated by IRCTC. Key responsibilities include supervision and monitoring of food production, quality and services; ensuring compliance of company policies and standard hospitality procedures; ensuring proper manpower and materials for nominated catering units; resolving customer/passenger care related issues and effective complaint management; collecting feedback, analysis and course correction; ensuring statutory compliance and regulations; supervising and educating staff in efficient upkeep of equipment and devices; and coordinating with various departments, offices, and business partners.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The latest Indian Army has officially announced the 144th Technical Graduate Course (TGC-144) Recruitment 2026 with 30 openings. Published on 12 May 2026 at joinindianarmy.nic.in, this new recruitment drive invites unmarried male Engineering Graduates for Permanent Commission. Candidates within the age range of 20 to 27 years and possessing a BE/B.Tech/M.Sc in the concerned engineering streams can apply online from 13 May 2026 to 11 June 2026. Find all details about the Indian Army TGC-144 2026 vacancy, including eligibility, online form, and notification PDF here.

FOLLOW US

Indian Army 144th Technical Graduate Course (TGC-144) Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

The Indian Army has officially released the notification for the 144th Technical Graduate Course (TGC-144) commencing January 2027 at Indian Military Academy (IMA), Dehradun, inviting applications from eligible unmarried male Engineering Graduates for Permanent Commission in the Indian Army. The notification includes complete details on vacancies, eligible engineering streams, eligibility criteria, selection process, training, pay structure, and application instructions. Candidates are strongly advised to download and read the full notification before applying online. The notification PDF is available on the official Indian Army Recruiting website.

  • Download Indian Army TGC-144 Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF

Indian Army TGC-144 Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

A total of 30 vacancies (tentative) have been announced for the 144th Technical Graduate Course (TGC-144) commencing January 2027. Vacancies are distributed across notified Engineering streams. These vacancies are subject to change or re-appropriation depending on organizational requirements. Recommended candidates of TGC-144 whose merit is not within the allotted vacancies of their respective Engineering streams may be offered Short Service Commission (Tech) Course (Apr 2027), subject to meeting all eligibility conditions and availability of unutilised vacancies.

Sl. No. Core Engineering Stream Engineering Streams Listed in AI No. of Vacancies
(a) Civil Civil; Architecture; Building Construction & Technology and equivalent AICTE-approved streams 08
(b) Computer Science Computer Sc & Engg; Computer Technology; M.Sc Computer Sc; Information Technology and equivalent AICTE-approved streams (including AI, Data Science, Cyber Security, IoT, Software Engg etc.) 06
(c) Electrical Electrical Engineering; Electrical and Electronics and equivalent AICTE-approved streams 02
(d) Electronics Electronics & Communication Engineering; Electronics & Instrumentation; Instrumentation; Electronics Engineering; Electronics & Telecommunication; Opto Electronics; Micro Electronics & Microwave; Fibre Optics; Satellite Communication and equivalent AICTE-approved streams 06
(e) Mechanical Mechanical Engineering; Production; Automobile; Industrial/Manufacturing; Workshop Technology; Aeronautical; Aerospace; Avionics and equivalent AICTE-approved streams 06
(f) Misc Engineering Streams Plastic Tech; Remote Sensing; Ballistics; Bio Medical Engg; Food Tech; Agriculture; Metallurgical; Metallurgy and Explosive; Laser Tech; Bio Tech; Rubber Technology; Chemical Engg; Transportation Engineering; Mining; Nuclear Technology; Textile and equivalent streams 02
Total 30

Note: Only the Engineering streams strictly as notified in the official notification (Para 3) will be accepted. Any variation between the nomenclature of engineering stream as given on the degree parchment/marksheet and that submitted in the online application will result in cancellation of candidature. Candidates with graduation from foreign countries are not permitted to apply.

Indian Army TGC-144 Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the closing date of online application (11-06-2026). Only unmarried male Engineering Graduates are eligible to apply. The educational qualification must be from a University/Institution recognized under an Act of Central or State Legislature in India, or educational institutions established by an Act of Parliament or declared to be deemed/Autonomous Universities under UGC Act 1956, IIT Act 1961, AICTE Act 1987, NITSER Act 2007 & IIIT Act 2024. Candidates with Engineering Degree from foreign countries are not eligible to apply.

Educational Qualification

Qualification Details
Engineering Degree (Mandatory) BE/B.Tech or M.Sc Computer Science in notified Engineering streams as listed in Para 3 of the official notification, from a recognized University/Institution.
Final Year Appearing Candidates Candidates in the final year of Engineering degree (whose final year/semester result will be declared by 01 Jan 2027) can also apply. They must submit proof of passing Engineering Degree Examination along with marksheets of all semesters/years by 01 Jan 2027 to TGC Entry, West Block III, R.K. Puram, New Delhi-110066 and produce the Engineering Degree Certificate within 12 weeks from the date of commencement of training at IMA.
Note (Final Year Candidates) ALL final year appearing candidates whose final year/final semester exam result will be declared AFTER 01 Jan 2027 are NOT eligible to apply. Final semester studying candidates will be provisionally allowed to appear in SSB subject to their cumulative percentage of marks upto 6th semester/3rd year not being below the approved cut-off percentage.
Marital Status Unmarried male only. Candidates must not marry until they complete full training at IMA, Dehradun.

Indian Army TGC-144 Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates must be between 20 to 27 years of age as on 01 January 2027. Unmarried candidates born not earlier than 01 January 2000 and not later than 01 January 2007 are eligible to apply. Only the date of birth as recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate or an equivalent (10th) certificate will be accepted; no other document relating to age will be accepted.

Category Age Limit (as on 01-01-2027)
All eligible candidates (Unmarried Male) 20 to 27 years (Born between 01 Jan 2000 and 01 Jan 2007)

Indian Army TGC-144 Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for Indian Army TGC-144 Recruitment 2026. Candidates are advised to visit the official website www.joinindianarmy.nic.in for any updates. Applications must be submitted online only and no hard copy of the application is to be sent to the Directorate General of Recruiting. Aadhaar number and Matriculation certificate are mandatory for registration on the website.

Indian Army TGC-144 Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for Indian Army TGC-144 Recruitment 2026 consists of multiple successive stages – shortlisting of applications based on cumulative percentage of marks in the Engineering degree (stream-wise), SSB Interview (five days), Medical Examination, Merit List, and issuance of Joining Letter. The final merit list is prepared engineering stream/subject wise on the basis of marks obtained at SSB interview only.

Merely qualifying at the SSB interview does not confirm final selection. If any candidate fails to report within 07 days from the reporting date mentioned in the Joining Letter without prior permission of the concerned academy Adjutant, their candidature will be cancelled and the next candidate in merit will be issued a joining letter.

Stage 1 - Shortlisting of Applications

Basis of Shortlisting Details
Cumulative Percentage of Marks (Stream-wise) Cut-off applied on cumulative percentage of marks upto final semester/year in each Engineering stream. For final year candidates, cumulative percentage upto 6th semester/3rd year must not be below approved cut-off. Shortlisting result to be published in month of June 2026.

Stage 2 - SSB Interview (Five Days)

Stage Details
Stage I Psychological test and Group Testing. Candidates who fail Stage I are returned on the same day.
Stage II Group Testing Officer tests and Interview by Interviewing Officer. Only those clearing Stage I proceed to Stage II.
SSB Centres Prayagraj (UP), Bhopal (MP), Bengaluru (Karnataka), Jalandhar (Punjab)
Likely SSB Dates July to September 2026 (SSB Centre & Date selection window open for two weeks in June 2026)

Stage 3 - Medical Examination

Candidates recommended by SSB will undergo Medical Examination. The validity of SSB medical examination is 270 days (SMB to PCTA joining date). Candidates already declared Med FIT in SSB medical of any service within 270 days need not undergo medical examination again. Medical standards as applicable for Officers Entry into Army. Proceedings of Medical Board are confidential.

Stage 4 - Merit List & Joining Letter

Merit list prepared engineering stream/subject wise on the basis of marks obtained at SSB interview. Tie-break 1: Older candidate ranked higher. Tie-break 2: Higher percentage of marks in degree (as per Para 3). Higher educational qualifications, previous performances etc. have no role. Joining Letters issued subject to vacancies and medical fitness.

6 Lunges Two Sets of 10 Repetitions
7 Swimming Should know fundamentals of swimming

Indian Army TGC-144 Recruitment 2026 - Training Details

Selected candidates will be detailed for training at Indian Military Academy (IMA), Dehradun for approximately 12 months (January 2027 to December 2027). On successful completion of training, cadets will be granted Permanent Commission in the rank of Lieutenant. One year ante date seniority from the date of commission will be granted to Engineering Graduates of TGC Entry for the purpose of seniority, promotion, and increment of pay.

Candidates will not be allowed to marry during the period of training. A candidate who marries subsequent to the date of application, though successful at SSB and medical, will not be inducted for training. The cost of training at IMA is at Government expense; candidates withdrawing for personal reasons will be liable to refund at Rs. 16,260/- per week (with 8% annual increment) as per MoD letter No. 16(1)/2017-D(GS.II) dt 15 Mar 22.

Indian Army TGC-144 Recruitment 2026 - Pay & Promotion Structure

On successful commissioning, the pay of the officer shall be fixed at the first cell of Level 10 in the Pay Matrix. The training period shall not be treated as commissioned service. A stipend of Rs. 56,100/- per month is payable during the entire duration of training at IMA, Dehradun. CTC on commissioning is approximately Rs. 17–18 Lakh per annum (excluding free medical cover and travel to home town once a year).

How to Apply for Indian Army TGC-144 Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the official Indian Army Recruiting website www.joinindianarmy.nic.in. Click on ‘Officer Entry Apply/Login’ and then click ‘Registration’ (registration not required if already registered). Fill the online registration form after reading the instructions carefully. After registering, click on ‘Apply Online’ under Dashboard, then click ‘Apply’ shown against Technical Graduate Course. The online portal will be active from 13-05-2026 (1500 hrs) to 11-06-2026 (1500 hrs). Aadhaar number and Matriculation certificate are mandatory for registration.

No changes to details submitted in the online application can be made after closure of application. Candidates must click on ‘Submit’ each time they open the application for editing. CGPA/Grades must be converted into Marks as per the formulae adopted by the concerned University before filling in the online application. Candidates must submit only one online application; receipt of multiple applications will result in cancellation of candidature. DIGILOCKER certificates will not be accepted in lieu of original certificates.

Documents to be Carried to SSB Interview (Self-attested copies along with Originals):

  • One copy of the printout of application duly signed and affixed with self-attested photograph
  • Matriculation/Secondary School Examination certificate and marksheet (proof of Date of Birth, candidate’s name and Parent’s name)
  • 12th class marksheet and certificate or equivalent certificate/Diploma marksheet
  • Engineering Degree/Provisional Degree issued by the recognised university (Provisional Degree not more than 6 months old at time of joining)
  • Marksheets of all semesters/years
  • Certificate from Controller of Examination/Registrar regarding CGPA/Grades to marks conversion formula
  • Certificate from Controller of Exam/Registrar/Dean/Principal regarding cumulative percentage of marks upto 6th semester/3rd year (for final year appearing candidates)
  • Certificate from Principal/Head of Institution stating candidate is in final year and result will be declared by 01 Jan 2027 (for final year appearing candidates)
  • Declaration by final year candidate regarding submission of proof of passing by 01 Jan 2027
  • Documents related to civil verification

The second copy of the printout of online application is to be retained by the candidate for reference. There is no need to send any hard copy to DG Recruiting. Candidates serving in Armed Forces must inform their Commanding Officer in writing and carry the application countersigned by the Commanding Officer to SSB.

Apply Online at: https://www.joinindianarmy.nic.in

Important Instructions for Indian Army TGC-144 Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only unmarried male Engineering Graduates who are citizens of India, subjects of Nepal, or persons of Indian origin from specified countries are eligible to apply.
  • Any variation between the nomenclature of Engineering stream as given on the degree parchment/marksheet and that submitted in the online application will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Any variation in personal particulars (candidate’s name & parents’ name) in educational documents requires submission of an affidavit stating the variations.
  • Candidate must carry ORIGINAL Degree/Provisional Degree and all semester/year marksheets for SSB.
  • No hard copy applications will be accepted – online submission only.
  • Candidates must not marry until they complete full training; violation will lead to discharge and recovery of training cost.
  • Candidate should not have been debarred from appearing in any examination by UPSC.
  • Candidate should not have been arrested/convicted by a criminal court or involved in any court case.
  • Candidates withdrawn from NDA, IMA, OTA, Naval Academy, Air Force Academy or any Service Training Academy on disciplinary grounds are not eligible to apply.
  • No compensation will be paid in respect of any injury sustained during SSB tests.
  • Once the SSB date has been selected, no request for change of SSB Interview Date/Centre will be entertained or replied to.
  • Candidates appearing for SSB interview for the first time are entitled to AC III Tier to-and-fro railway fare or bus fare including reservation-cum-sleeper charges within Indian limits.
  • Candidates are advised to visit https://www.joinindianarmy.nic.in regularly for updates. Queries will be replied only through the ‘Feedback/Queries’ option on the website. Queries received up to 03 days prior to closing of online application will only be entertained/replied.
  • In case of any discrepancy between Hindi and English versions of the notification, the English version will prevail.

Indian Army TES-56 Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

Indian Army TES-56 Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the closing date of online application (12-06-2026). Only unmarried male candidates who have passed 10+2 with PCM subjects from a recognized education board and appeared in JEE (Mains) 2026 are eligible to apply. Knowledge of Bengali or Kokborok is not applicable for this entry. Candidates must possess the prescribed minimum qualification on the closing date of application submission; admission at all stages is provisional and subject to eligibility verification.

Indian Army TES-56 Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

A candidate must not be below 16½ years and above 19½ years on the first day of the month in which the course is due to commence i.e. 01 January 2027. Only the date of birth as recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary School Examination (10th) certificate will be accepted; no other document relating to age will be accepted.

Indian Army TES-56 Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for Indian Army TES-56 Recruitment 2026 consists of multiple successive stages – shortlisting of applications based on JEE Mains CRL, SSB Interview (five days), Medical Examination, Merit List, and finally issuance of Joining Letter. Candidates who qualify the SSB will be called for Medical Examination. The final merit list is based solely on marks obtained in the SSB Interview.

Merely qualifying at the SSB interview does not confirm final selection. If any candidate fails to report at the allotted CTW within 07 days from the allotted date of reporting, their candidature will be cancelled and the next candidate in merit will be upgraded to fill the vacancy.

Stage 1 - Shortlisting of Applications

Basis of Shortlisting Details
JEE Mains 2026 Common Rank List (CRL) Cut-off to be fixed by Integrated HQ of MoD (Army) without assigning any reason. Shortlisting result tentatively in first week of July 2026.

Stage 2 - SSB Interview (Five Days)

Stage Details
Stage I Psychological test, Group Testing. Candidates who fail Stage I are returned on the same day.
Stage II Group Testing Officer tests and Interview by Interviewing Officer. Only those clearing Stage I proceed to Stage II.
SSB Centres Prayagraj (UP), Bhopal (MP), Bengaluru (Karnataka), Jalandhar (Punjab)
Likely SSB Dates August to September 2026

Stage 3 - Medical Examination

Candidates recommended by SSB will undergo Medical Examination at the nearest Military Hospital. Medical standards as applicable for Officers Entry into Army. Proceedings of Medical Board are confidential.

Stage 4 - Merit List & Joining Letter

Merit list prepared solely on the basis of marks obtained in SSB Interview. Higher educational qualifications, previous performances, NCC background etc. have no role in finalization of merit list. Joining Letters issued subject to vacancies and medical fitness.

Indian Army TES-56 Recruitment 2026 - Training Details

The total training duration is 4 years (3+1) at Pre-Commissioned Training Academies (PCTA). Phase-I consists of 3 years of Integrated Basic Military Training & Engineering Training at Cadets Training Wings located at CME Pune / MCTE Mhow / MCEME Secunderabad. Phase-II consists of 1 year of Integrated Basic Military Training & Engineering Training at Indian Military Academy (IMA), Dehradun. On successful completion of 4 years of training, cadets will be awarded an Engineering degree and granted Permanent Commission in the rank of Lieutenant.

Phase II 1 Year Indian Military Academy (IMA), Dehradun Integrated Basic Military Training & Engineering Training

Indian Army TES-56 Recruitment 2026 - Pay & Promotion Structure

On successful commissioning, the pay of the officer shall be fixed at the first cell of Level 10 in the Pay Matrix. The training period shall not be treated as commissioned service. A stipend of Rs. 56,100/- per month is payable at IMA only (after 3 years of training). CTC on commissioning is approximately Rs. 17–18 Lakh per annum (excluding free medical cover and travel to home town once a year).

(HPSCB), Head Office - The Mall, Shimla (H.P.) - 171001 has officially released the detailed notification for recruitment to 91 posts of Junior Clerks (quota for PACS/OCS of HP) on Regular Basis through IBPS, Mumbai. HPSCB Junior Clerk Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on 01-01-2026. All reserved category candidates must be Bonafide Himachalis. Reservation benefits are applicable only to Bonafide Himachali candidates. OBC candidates must submit a valid Non-Creamy Layer certificate from competent authority. Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBDs/Ex-SM and other reserved categories of HP may apply against unreserved/general category posts but will not be eligible for age relaxation or fee concession in such cases. Candidates must also ensure they are not directly or indirectly a defaulter of their society.

Experience certificates must be issued by the concerned Inspector of Society and countersigned by the Assistant Registrar, Cooperative Societies of H.P. with authentic certification. Such certificate must be supported by: (i) Copy of resolution of the managing committee for initial appointment, and (ii) Copy of relevant pages of statutory audit report/note for prescribed years showing payment of wages/salary from the society account.

Educational Qualification

Post / Quota Essential Qualifications
Junior Clerk (PACS Quota - Trained Secretaries of PACS of HP) (i) Graduate in any discipline from a recognized University (Candidates must have passed Matriculation and 10+2 from a School/Institution within Himachal Pradesh - not applicable for Bonafide Himachalis); (ii) Minimum 3 years continuous service as Secretary as defined in Rule 2(vii) of H.P. Cooperative Societies Rules, 1971 of Primary Agriculture Credit Society; (iii) All employees of PACS covered under definition of "Trained Secretaries" are eligible; (iv) Candidate should not be a defaulter of his/her society
Junior Clerk (OCS Quota - Employees of Other Cooperative Societies and PACS employees not covered as Trained Secretaries) (i) Graduate in any discipline from a recognized University (Matriculation and 10+2 from HP school - not applicable for Bonafide Himachalis); (ii) Minimum 5 years continuous service in a cooperative society; (iii) All employees of other cooperative societies and PACS employees not covered under definition of "Trained Secretaries" are eligible; (iv) Candidate should not be a defaulter of his/her society

HPSCB Junior Clerk Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates must be above 18 years and below 45 years of age as on 01-01-2026. Candidates born between 02-01-1981 and 01-01-2008 (both days inclusive) are eligible. Age relaxation is applicable only to Bonafide Himachali candidates of the respective reserved categories. Selected PwBD candidates will have to submit a Medical Certificate from a competent authority confirming physical fitness to perform duties.

HPSCB Junior Clerk Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates applying for the post of Junior Clerk are required to pay a non-refundable application fee as specified below. The fee must be paid online through the HPSCB application portal. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Bank transaction charges for online payment will have to be borne by the candidate.

Category Application Fee

SC / ST / IRDP / BPL / ANTODAYA of HP Rs. 800/- (Rupees Eight Hundred only) - Non-refundable
Female Candidates of All Categories of HP Rs. 800/- (Rupees Eight Hundred only) - Non-refundable

HPSCB Junior Clerk Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for HPSCB Junior Clerk Recruitment 2026 consists of 2 stages - Online Examination (150 marks, 150 minutes, conducted through IBPS Mumbai) followed by Document Verification/Scrutiny. There is no personal interview. Candidates up to 1.75 times of vacant posts will be called for document verification. Final selection will be made strictly on the basis of merit in the online examination after document verification. Candidates must score minimum 40% marks in the online examination to be shortlisted for document verification. Candidates declared successful who do not personally attend document verification will have their candidature cancelled.

Stage 1 - Online Examination (150 Marks, 150 Minutes)

3 English 30 30

Stage 2 - Document Verification / Scrutiny

Shortlisting Ratio Candidates up to 1.75 times of vacant posts will be called for document verification
Minimum Qualifying Marks 40% of total marks (i.e., minimum 60 out of 150) in online examination
No Negative Marking There is NO negative marking in the online examination
Question Paper Type Objective type multiple choice (MCQ) - bilingual (English and Hindi)

Tie-Breaking Rules

1st Tie-Break Preference to candidates possessing higher academic qualifications
2nd Tie-Break Preference to candidates belonging to the State of H.P.

HPSCB Junior Clerk Recruitment 2026 - Exam Syllabus

The Online Examination consists of 5 sections - Reasoning, Numerical Ability, English, General Awareness, and H.P. Cooperative Societies Act and Rules - each carrying 30 marks (total 150 marks, 150 minutes). The level of examination and syllabus is in accordance with the minimum educational qualification criteria i.e. Graduation level. The question paper is bilingual (English and Hindi) and is of objective type MCQ. There is no negative marking. Preference will be given to candidates possessing knowledge of customs, traditions, languages, and culture of Himachal Pradesh and the test shall include questions on such subjects.

Section Topic Key Coverage Marks
Section 1 Reasoning Logical Reasoning, Analytical Reasoning, Verbal and Non-Verbal Reasoning 30
Section 2 Numerical Ability Quantitative Aptitude, Number Systems, Arithmetic, Data Interpretation 30
Section 3 English Reading Comprehension, Grammar, Vocabulary, Sentence Completion 30
Section 4 General Awareness (including HP GK) General Awareness, Current Affairs, HP General Knowledge, Customs, Traditions, Languages and Culture of Himachal Pradesh 30
Section 5 H.P. Cooperative Societies Act & H.P. Cooperative Societies Rules Provisions of HP Cooperative Societies Act and HP Cooperative Societies Rules 30

How to Apply for HPSCB Junior Clerk Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the Bank's website www.hpscb.bank.in by clicking the "APPLY ONLINE" option. Hard copy applications or applications by any other mode will not be accepted. The online application window is open from 09-05-2026 to 29-05-2026. Candidates must register on the portal, make fee payment online, and upload all required documents. No change will be possible after clicking the "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" button. Candidates are advised to keep their valid personal email ID and mobile number active till the completion of the entire recruitment process.

Before applying, candidates must have ready: scanned photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm), signature (with black ink on white paper), left thumb impression (on white paper with black or blue ink), and a hand-written declaration in English on white paper with black ink. Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted. The hand-written declaration text is: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."

  • Experience Certificate countersigned by Assistant Registrar, Cooperative Societies of H.P. - with copy of managing committee resolution for initial appointment and statutory audit report pages (3 years for PACS quota; 5 years for OCS quota)
  • Age proof (10th/12th class mark sheet/certificate)

  • EWS Income and Asset Certificate issued by Deputy Commissioner/SDO (Civil)/Tehsildar (for EWS candidates) - family income below Rs. 4 Lakhs per annum
  • PwBD Certificate (minimum 40% disability) + Medical Certificate from competent authority confirming fitness for duty (for PwBD candidates)
  • Discharge Certificate (for Ex-Servicemen candidates)
  • WFF Certificate (for Ward of Freedom Fighter candidates)
  • IRDP/BPL/Antodaya Certificate countersigned by Block Development Officer (if applicable)
  • NOC and Good Character Certificate from current employer (for candidates in regular/confirmed service)
  • e-Receipt and printout of online application form

HPSCB Junior Clerk Recruitment 2026 - Application Link and Form Details

The online application for HPSCB Junior Clerk Recruitment 2026 is to be filled and submitted through the Bank's official website. The step-by-step process is as follows:

Step Action Details
Step 1 Visit Bank's Website Go to www.hpscb.bank.in → Click "APPLY ONLINE" → Choose "Click here for New Registration" → Enter Name, Contact Details, and Email ID → Note the Provisional Registration Number and Password generated
Step 2 Fill the Application Form Fill all personal details, category, qualification, and experience details. Use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save data if unable to complete in one go. Details must match exactly as in certificates/mark sheets.
Step 3 Upload Documents Upload: (1) Photograph (4.5×3.5 cm, 20-50 KB, JPG); (2) Signature (black ink, 10-20 KB, JPG); (3) Left Thumb Impression (black/blue ink on white paper, 20-50 KB, JPG); (4) Hand-written Declaration (black ink on white paper, English only, 50-100 KB, JPG). Capture live webcam photo as required.
Step 4 Preview and Complete Registration Click "Preview Tab" to verify all details → Modify if required → Click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" only after verifying everything is correct. No changes allowed after this step.
Step 5 Pay Application Fee Click "Payment" Tab → Pay online via Debit Card (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, or Mobile Wallets → Wait for server intimation (do not press Back/Refresh) → Download e-Receipt

Apply Online at: https://ibpsreg.ibps.in/hpscbmar26/

Important Instructions for HPSCB Junior Clerk Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • All reserved category benefits including age relaxation and fee concession apply only to Bonafide Himachali candidates.
  • Candidates must possess valid experience certificate from their cooperative society - false experience certificates will result in summary cancellation of candidature irrespective of qualifying the online examination.
  • Experience certificates must be issued by the concerned Inspector of Society and countersigned by the Assistant Registrar, Cooperative Societies of H.P. supported by managing committee resolution and statutory audit report pages.
  • No hard copy applications will be accepted - online submission only via www.hpscb.bank.in.
  • Application fee is non-refundable; fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS and hand-written declaration not in candidate's own handwriting or not in English will be treated as invalid.
  • Candidates already in regular (confirmed) service must submit NOC and good character certificate from current employer at document verification - absence of NOC will result in cancellation of candidature.

  • OBC candidates must submit a valid Non-Creamy Layer certificate; EWS candidates must have family gross annual income below Rs. 4 Lakhs per annum.
  • PwBD candidates must have minimum 40% degree of disability and must submit Medical Certificate from competent authority confirming fitness for duty at selected post.
  • Wards of Ex-Servicemen are NOT eligible for posts advertised for Ex-Servicemen.
  • Selected candidates will be on probation for a period of two years (extendable up to maximum 3 years).
  • No TA/DA is admissible for appearing in the online examination.
  • Selected candidates will be posted anywhere in the area of operation of H.P. State Cooperative Bank in Himachal Pradesh.
  • For any dispute related to selection process, the decision of the Registrar, Co-operative Societies of Himachal Pradesh shall be binding and final; jurisdiction shall be Shimla (HP) only.
  • Candidates are advised to visit www.hpscb.bank.in regularly for all updates regarding the recruitment process.

SBI Concurrent Auditor Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the date of advertisement i.e. 14-05-2026. Only retired officers of SBI (and its e-Associate banks) who retired on superannuation at the age of 60 years are eligible. Officers who voluntarily retired, resigned, were suspended, or left the Bank before superannuation are not eligible, except those who completed 58 years of age and 30 years of service/pensionable service (both conditions) as per e-Circular No. CDO/P&HRD-PM/20/2022-23 dated 21.06.2022, who become eligible on attaining the age of 60 years.

Educational Qualification & Experience

Parameter Details
Educational Qualification Not Applicable (NA)
Experience (Preferred) Work experience in the area of credit / audit / Forex background is preferred.
Eligible Scales (Retired Grade) MMGS-III, SMGS-IV, SMGS-V, TEGS-VI – retired from SBI or its e-Associate banks on superannuation
Performance & Integrity Officers should have good track record of performance and thorough knowledge of Bank’s systems and procedures. Integrity should not have been doubtful during service. No punishment/penalty (Censure or higher) should have been inflicted during the five years preceding retirement. No CBI or law enforcement agency cases pending.
Health The Retired Officer should maintain good health and not be suffering from any major ailments.
Other Conditions The retired officers will not accept any assignment with any other organization during the period of contractual service. The applicant should have been retired as on the date of submitting the application.

SBI Concurrent Auditor Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

The maximum age as on the date of advertisement i.e. 14-05-2026 should be 63 years for fresh engagement (as the engagement is for a maximum of 3 years or up to attainment of 65 years of age, whichever is earlier). No relaxation in upper age limit will be available to reserved category candidates. The officer should have retired from the Bank’s service on attaining superannuation at the age of 60 years.

There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for SBI Concurrent Auditor Recruitment 2026. Candidates are advised to check the official SBI Careers website for any updates. Candidates are required to apply online only; no hard copy of the application or other documents is required to be sent to this office.

SBI Concurrent Auditor Recruitment 2026 - Remuneration

The engaged retired officers will be paid a monthly lumpsum compensation (for full time work) as detailed below, without any perquisites and without prejudice to pension. There will be no provision for house/furniture by the Bank nor other benefits/perquisites/PF/pension fund/gratuity during the contract period. Income tax will be deducted at source as per prevailing IT rules.

SBI Concurrent Auditor Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for SBI Concurrent Auditor Recruitment 2026 is based on Shortlisting and Interview. Merely fulfilling the minimum qualification and experience will not vest any right in the candidate for being called for interview. The Shortlisting Committee constituted by the Bank will decide the shortlisting parameters. Adequate number of candidates, as decided by the Bank, will be shortlisted and called for interview. The decision of the Bank to call candidates for interview shall be final.

Interview will carry 100 marks. The qualifying marks in the interview will be decided by the Bank. Merit list for final selection will be prepared in descending order of scores obtained in the interview only. In case more than one candidate scores common cut-off marks, such candidates will be ranked in descending order of their age. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates appearing in the interview process.

Shortlisting & Interview Process

Stage Details
Shortlisting Based on eligibility criteria, qualification, suitability and experience. Shortlisting parameters decided by the Bank. Decision of the Bank is final.
Interview 100 marks. Conducted by the interview committee. Decision of the committee is final and binding. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
Merit List Prepared in descending order of scores in interview only. Tie-break: Descending order of age. Candidates scoring minimum qualifying marks will be considered.
Deployment Retired officers will be selected and kept in a pool. Pool valid for 1 year from date of declaration of results or till issuance of fresh advertisement, whichever is earlier. Officers deployed against vacancies available; non-acceptance of preferred centre offer results in removal from merit list.

Tie-Breaking Rules

1st Tie-Break Descending order of age (older candidate ranked higher)

SBI Concurrent Auditor Recruitment 2026 - Roles & Responsibilities

The service of the engaged retired officers shall be used for the following purposes: verifying all loan documents and ensuring compliance of all processes of sanction and follow-up as per Bank’s guidelines; verifying deposit accounts and ensuring compliance of all related instructions; verifying other areas like remittances, bill transactions, foreign exchange, cash transactions and all other day-to-day activities including external compliance. The Internal Audit Department will decide the scope of audit from time to time as per extant provisions of the Bank. The engaged Concurrent Auditor will work at branches/outfits under the supervision of the GM(IA) of the respective CAO.

How to Apply for SBI Concurrent Auditor Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the SBI Careers website https://www.sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings. Candidates will be required to register themselves online through the link available on SBI website. After registering online, candidates are advised to take a printout of the system generated online application form. Candidates should first scan their latest photograph and signature and upload them as per prescribed guidelines. The online application will be active from 14-05-2026 to 11-06-2026.

In case a candidate is not able to fill the application in one go, the partly filled form can be saved; a provisional registration number and password will be generated. The facility of editing saved information will be available for three times only. Only one application will be accepted from the Retired Officer for applying at one Circle; in case of multiple applications, only the last valid (completed) application will be accepted. Hard copy of application and other documents is not required to be sent to this office. Call letters for interview will be sent by e-mail only (no hard copy will be sent).

Documents to be Uploaded at the Time of Online Application:

  • Brief particulars of experience of last 10 years (assignment-wise details) – PDF
  • ID Proof – PDF
  • Proof of Date of Birth – PDF
  • Copy of PPO (Pension Payment Order)
  • Recent Passport size Photograph (JPG/JPEG, 20–50 kb, 200 x 230 pixels)
  • Signature (JPG/JPEG, 10–20 kb, 140 x 60 pixels, Black ink on white paper)
  • EWS / Caste Certificate (if applicable) – PDF
  • Any other relevant document (if available) – PDF

Documents must be in PDF format, A4 size, not exceeding 500 kb. EWS candidates are required to produce the ‘Income & Asset Certificate’ based on gross annual income for Financial Year 2025-26, valid for 2026-27 as per extant DoPT guidelines, at the time of document verification during interview.

Apply Online at: https://www.sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings

  • Only retired officers of SBI (and its e-Associate banks) who retired on superannuation at age 60 in the scales of MMGS-III, SMGS-IV/V or TEGS-VI are eligible to apply.

SECR Nagpur Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates must be minimum 15 years and not more than 24 years of age as on 19-05-2026. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), Divyang/PWBD and Ex-Servicemen (10 years). For Ex-Servicemen, an additional 10 years relaxation (plus 3 years if continuous service of 6 months) is also applicable. Age relaxation for OBC and SC/ST candidates is subject to submission of the latest caste certificate in central format. The upper age limit shall not exceed the relaxed limit in any case.

SECR Nagpur Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will be based on a merit list prepared for all candidates who apply against the notification. The merit list will be prepared on the basis of percentage of marks in Matriculation (minimum 50% aggregate) plus ITI marks in the trade in which Apprenticeship is to be done. For candidates from boards like Board of Secondary Education Andhra Pradesh and Board of Public Examination Kerala (grade-based systems), SECR Nagpur Division will take the midpoint of the range of grades obtained, treating each subject as out of 100 marks for average calculation. Shortlisted candidates will be subject to verification of all original testimonials and appropriate medical examination. After selection, requests to change division/unit will not be entertained.

Tie-Breaking Rules

1st Tie-Break Candidate with older age shall be preferred
2nd Tie-Break Candidate who passed Matriculation exam earlier shall be considered first (if date of birth is also the same)

The online portal will be active from 19-05-2026 to 18-06-2026 (23:59 hrs).

Candidates must carefully fill their 10th and ITI marks on the portal in the qualification section - if these marks do not appear in the downloaded Excel file, the candidature will be rejected. Do not fill any other higher qualification. Candidates have to choose either Nagpur Division or Motibagh Workshop at the time of application.

A unique registration number will be issued to each applicant during online submission - candidates are advised to save/note it for future correspondence. If the EWS/Ex-Servicemen option is not available on the portal, apply under your actual category and submit the EWS/Ex-Servicemen certificate physically to this office.

No daily allowance, conveyance allowance, or travelling allowance will be paid to candidates called for document verification. No accommodation will be provided by Railway for apprentices.

KRCL Mechanical Department Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria may report directly for the walk-in interview at the specified venue with all original certificates and one copy of application in prescribed format (Annexure-A) along with one set of self-attested copies of all required certificates. Registration will be done between 09:00 hrs and 12:00 hrs only on the date of walk-in interview.

After preliminary screening of applications submitted in person, only provisionally eligible candidates will be interviewed. Group Discussion (GD) or any other elimination round like written test may be introduced depending on the number of candidates; only those who clear the elimination round will be called for further selection. The nominated Committee’s decision shall be final and binding. No train/bus fare/TA/DA shall be payable by KRCL for attending the walk-in interview. Candidates should come prepared to stay for a minimum of 2 days if required, at their own cost.

How to Apply for KRCL Mechanical Department Recruitment 2026

Candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria may report directly for the walk-in interview at the venue on the specified date and time for their respective post. Candidates must fill and bring one copy of the application in the prescribed format (Annexure-A attached with the notification), available on the KRCL website at www.konkanrailway.com under Recruitment > Current Notifications. Registration time is strictly 09:00 hrs to 12:00 hrs only on the date of walk-in interview. Applications not conforming to the prescribed format or having illegible/ambiguous certificates or without certificates or incomplete will be summarily rejected. Any kind of canvassing will result in disqualification of the candidate at any stage of selection without assigning any reason.

  • Copy of service certificate in support of claims for Ex-servicemen, if any
  • Experience Certificate issued by previous employer
  • Two passport size recent photographs
  • Character certificate from Gazetted Officer/Executive Officer certifying good moral character

All original certificates must also be brought for verification at the time of the walk-in interview. Selected candidates will be required to pass a prescribed medical examination before the contract is entered into. Selected candidates must be able to join within a maximum of 30 days after issuance of offer of appointment. Selected candidates will be required to execute an agreement and indemnity bond of Rs. 50,000/- in favour of KRCL on stamp paper of Rs. 100/- or more.

Walk-in Interview Venue: Administrative Building, Wagon Repair Workshop, Autonagar, Vadlapudi, Gajuwaka, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.

  • No accommodation will be provided and no Food/Mess Allowance will be paid by KRCL.
  • Even after contractual agreement, if any document/certificate/information is found incorrect or false, contractual service will be immediately terminated without prior notice, besides legal action.
  • Candidates who are already working in KRCL on contract basis and selected against this notification do not require to follow the condition of notice period for joining the new post; however, a relieving letter from the concerned Konkan Railway authority will be required at the time of joining.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to cancel/restrict/curtail/enlarge the contract engagement process without any prior notice and without assigning any reason.

  • Statutory Income Tax, Professional Tax, and other applicable taxes will be deducted at source.

Collaborate closely with oncologists, surgeons, and other specialists to develop and implement comprehensive treatment plans.
